\uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 109v\endash 124r {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://bezwrk[0].6930/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Excerpta theologica (Auctoritates)}}\plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 109v\endash 111r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Sequitur notabile bonum doctorum in sentenciis< Diceres quomodo debet homo facere diligenciam ut securior sit et non sit ignorans. Secundum apostolum ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... vos autem expelli foras etc., Luce tredecimo \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (28)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 etc. etc. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Auch in Wien, Schottenstift, 330 (246) (54.h.3), f.81v\endash 83. \line 111r\endash v Nicolaus de Lyra: Super Mt 7,14 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Nota: Nicolaus de Lyra super illud Matthei septimo \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (14)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 : Arta est via que ducit ad regnum et pauci intrant ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... idest virtuose et bene agere. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 111v\endash 112v Similitudo de morte \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Nota pulchram similitudinem de morte Sicut videmus ad sensum quia omnia flumina dulcia moventur et fluunt quousque ad suum terminum scilicet mare veniant ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... Proverbiorum octavo \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (34)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 beatus qui audit me qui vigilat ad fores meas tota die (!) et observat ad \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 [postes ostii mei]\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 112v\endash 113v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Actende (!) dei pulsum. Apok. 3\u176 \'b0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (20)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 : Ego sto ad hostium et pulso. Beatus enim servus ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Lc 12,43)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . Ex hoc enim perficitur homo ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... Super quo Gregorius 7\u176 \'b0 Moralium capitulo 28 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (7,19)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 : Ideo inquit deus (!), quibus hic parcit, ut in perpetuum feriat. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 113v\endash 114v Exzerpte \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Nota sicut malus spiritus non audet vim facere trahiciendo hominem in peccatum, sicut nec ausus fuit Christum proicere de pin\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 [n]\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 aculo templi ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Folge von Zitaten aus \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Augustinus in quodam sermone de laudando deum, Ieronimus in epistola ad Nepocianum, Boecius \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 und \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Ambrosius. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 114v\endash 116r Exzerpte \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Nota Humbertus in eppistola (!) ad religiosos de consensu illicito sic dicit: Duplicem esse consensum qui nos maculat ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 115r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Augustinus de agone Christiano capitulo 14 dicit quod medicina hominum tanta est ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (11,12 ed. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Zycha\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 S.115,8), 115v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Ambrosius, Anshelmus \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 116r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Bernhardus in sermone de annunciacione et in flo. (?) libro ultimo capitulo 6\u176 \'b0 ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 116v\endash 118v Spruchhafte Zitate aus der Bibel und Gregorius \line (118v) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Wersus: Aspera disce pati si vis eterna lucrari. Vincit qui patitur, si vis vincere disce pati. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 119r Notae, darunter Caesarius-Exzerpt aus dem 'Speculum historiale' des Vinzenz von Beauvais \line 124r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Metrista: Sunt tria que vere faciunt me sepe dolere Est primum durum, quia scio me moriturum. Gemo secundo quia morior nescio quando. Tercio magis flebo quia nescio quo remanebo. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Walther\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , Initia 18886 (mit dieser Hs.). Diese Versus morales (4) ferner in Bruxelles, BR, 2653\endash 2662 (V.d.G. 2057), f.114v; Cambrai, BM, 260 (250), f.72v; M\u252 \'fcnchen, UB, 2\u176 \'b0 731, f. 212. Vgl. J.-P. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Rothschild\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , Bibliographie annuelle du Moyen Age tardif 2 (1992) n\u176 \'b0 3156, und \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Bloomfield\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 5877 (Kopenhagen, KB, Gl. kgl. S. 1382 4to, f.49r\endash 51v, umfangreicher). \emdash \line Endet 124r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... Beatus qui intelligit super egenum et pauperem etc. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Ps 40,2)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash Rest der Seite leer}

Finitis narrationibus capitulorum ... Et primo de premissione quorumdam psalmorum qui ante missam leguntur. Sacerdos celebraturus missarum sollempnia psalmos et oraciones premittit hos scilicet Quam dilecta ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (I 47) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Cumque psalmos dicit sacerdos ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash 91v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 .... Ideoque illam benediccionem sacerdos facit in nomine patris et filii et spiritus sancti. Amen. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Schlu\u223 \'df wie Aschaffenburg, 35, f.23ra; N\u252 \'fcrnberg, Cent. IV,71 f.175r). \line 92r\endash 95r Verse \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Primo quod in mensa agatur< Officium misse valet obsequium super omne / Quidquid pro nobis Christus sustinuit et egit ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... Verbis et signis fiet benediccio, finis. Amen \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Auch in N\u252 \'fcrnberg, Cent.IV,71, f.175r\endash 176va; ferner in zwei Bamberger Hss. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Walther\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , Initia 13151). Kurzfassung des Textes in PL 217, c.773\endash 916. Vgl. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Wright\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , A medieval commentary, S.61. \line 95r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >De officio misse< Officium misse tam provida reperitur disposicione dispositum ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... quandam speciem representat. \line Petrus in scolastica hystoria de partibus misse: Videndum est quod ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Es folgen verschiedene Texte zur Messe, darunter Gebete. (Auch in N\u252 \'fcrnberg, Cent.IV,71). \emdash \line Ende 106v, letztes St\u252 \'fcck, Gebet: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Domine Ihesu Criste filii dei vivi qui ex voluntate patris ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 et a te numquam in eternum separari. Amen. >Explicit materia bona Innocencii de officio misse etc.< \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash Mit marginalen Glossen (besonders 55v\endash 61v u.\u246 \'f6.) \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Vgl. auch \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Maccarone\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Studi su Innocenzo III, S.428f.}

\uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 153v\endash 159v {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://bezwrk[0].6930/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Confessionis exemplum}}\plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Sacerdos dilecte ponam unam brevem confessionem de excessibus cottidianis levibus sine quibus humano modo nullus \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (corr.)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 presbyterorum est ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 154r\endash 158v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Ego reus et conscius omnium meorum peccatorum confiteor contritus omnipotenti deo beate Marie virgini et omnibus sanctis et vobis patri spirituali loco dei, quod peccavi nimis a preterita confessione ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... habeo propositum me emendandi et ut semper oretur deum pro me, quod pro vobis vice versa libenter faciam. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 158v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Ecce sacerdos dilecte confessionem simplicibus scripsi, ex paucis multa collige. Et nota sub absolucione semper debes signare frontem cruce propter efficaciam passionis ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... veritatem tacere possumus loquitur beatus Augustinus: Sis ergo discretus in omnibus, ut sis irreprehensibilis in omnibus. Quod nobis omnibus prestare dignetur benedictus virginis filius in eternum regnans unicus in unione deitatis cum patre et spiritu sancto. Amen. etc. etc. etc. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Zu f.154r vgl. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Bloomfield\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Nr.1893. Secundo qualiter et quomodo sunt hore canonice invente ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Vorwort \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Ad honorem illius cuius sunt opera inseparabilia scilicet sancte et individue trinitatis ... Licet ebes et rudis ingenio et imbecillis iurium intellectu confisus tamen ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 125v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Nota primo ex C. certum modum et ordinem in divinis officiis debere servari ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash 126r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... Tractatus illustrium ..., Venedig 1584. \emdash Weitere Zeugen siehe 'Gesamtindex'. }

\uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 145r\endash 166v {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://bezper[0].4100/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Iohannes Kortz (Kotz) (?)}}\plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 : {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://bezwrk[0].6930/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Compendium operis tripartiti Iohannis Gersonis}}\plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Tractatus de preceptis et confessionibus et sciencia mortis sub compendio et tenore tocius fidei Christiane nimis perutilis aureis litteris conscribendum (!). \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Verse {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://5650[0].5666l/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 O quam libellus hic brevis sit atque tenellus}}\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 / \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Est tamen sequendus et super actus amandus, \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 / \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 A bonis tenendus, fidorum corda scribendus. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 / \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Nam eius doctrina fert ad amena gaudia \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 / \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Omnes fideles non ficte sed vere credentes. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 / \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Metra dactilica per Iohannem Kocz (!) sunt facta. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 / \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Sane (?) vitentur a pedibus si claudicentur \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 / \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Nam eius regule metrorum sunt evanate (?). \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Vgl. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Walther\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , Initia 12895a (Vers 1 lies 'brevis hic'). Statt 'O quam' wohl 'quamquam'. \emdash Rest der Seite und 145v leer. \line 146r Anfang des Gerson-Textes \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Christianitati suus qualiscumque zelator prosperum ad virtutes viciis depulsis incrementum. Salubre duxi sequens opusculum alias tripartitum de preceptis, de confessione, de sciencia mortis ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... si continue presentaretur, sicut in domo dei Parisius laudabiliter observatur. etc. Et sic est finis. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Rot gerahmt: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Completum in vigilia conversionis sancti Pauli anno domini etc. XXXXVIII. >Hec est de tractatu egregii doctoris magistri cancellarii studii universitatis Parisiensis< >Ihesu bone miserere< \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash Vorn im Inhaltsverzeichnis aufgef\u252 \'fchrt. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Ausgabe des Gerson-Textes: \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Du Pin\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , 1706, I col.427\endash 442. Des Widmungsbriefes: \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Glorieux\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Jean Gerson, Oeuvres compl\u232 \'e8tes, II, Nr.18 S.74}
Quamquam libellus hic brevis sit atque tenellus

Et a malo liberet in eternum amen. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 / \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Qui pugnat contra dominum, retribuit (!) in infernum< Hec sunt dicta egregii doctoris Hainrici de Hassia edita pro erudicione religiosorum. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash 50 Vierzeiler. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Siehe \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Wattenbach\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Die Anf\u228 \'e4nge latein. profaner Rythmen des MA, in: ZfdA 15 (1872) 477. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Hohmann\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Initienregister, S.403. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Madre\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Nikolaus von Dinkelsb\u252 \'fchl, S.298. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Walther\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Initia 2772. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Bloomfield\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Nr.742 (mit dieser Hs.) \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 197v\endash 198r Diffinitio theologica proprietatis \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Diffinicio theoloyca proprietatis in religione< Nota secundum doctores sacre theologie proprietatis (!) est caritatis gelicidium, fraternitatis naufragium ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... sed eciam iustum iudicium dei sustinebunt etc.}

Suscipit hunc fructum cupiens vitare reatum. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (2) Prosa \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Fratres mei considerate< Indigna communio hominem peccatis illaqueat, dampnacionem preparat, proximum scandalizat, mentem excecat, temptacioni subiungat ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 202v Schlie\u223 \'dft mit Exzerpten aus \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Hylarius, Bernhardus. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (3) Verse \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Considerate vos sacerdotes< Sit licet indignus qui sacre presidet are, Sorde tamen nulla valet hoc sacrum violare. Sicut deterius non fit per deteriorem, Sic non fit melius per presbiterum meliorem ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... Ipsa caro deus est, qui negat hoc reus est ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... tamen integer esus. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 (1) \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Walther\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Initia 11108. \emdash (3) \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Walther\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Initia 18317}

\uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 213v\endash 216r {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://bezwrk[0].6930/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Versus morales}}\plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Sit formido dei prefixa tue faciei Hanc tibi prepone vigili mentis racione ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Abschnitte durch Lombarden hervorgehoben: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Cerne voluntatem propriam velud impietatem. Hanc contemptor amat, sed vox divina reclamat ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 214r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Subdere maiori studeas, parare (!) priori, Subditus esto pari, minimo cupias famulari ... \line Si tibi res dure mandatur, suscipe pure, Profer secure mercedis amore future ... \line Si mens incesta mala cogitet ac inhonesta, Profer ne celes, patri commissa reveles ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 214v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Res nimis exilis, sors ultima, porcio vilis Si tibi donatur sine murmure suscipiatur ... Cunctis peiorem te cunctis (?) inferiorem Puro corde ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 215r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Nemo privatum quidquam reputet si gratum Illud proponat ... Sis omnis custos, decet omnis ianua iustos Quando taces magis inde places ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 215v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Partibus invisus levis est super omnia risus Turpiter elisus plano de corde recisus ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 216r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Cum proferis verba caveat (!) a voce superba. Sit tibi sermo gravis humilis vox lingwa suavis ... \line Cum fueris factus humilis in nichilumque redactus Virtutem nactus virtutem pande per actus ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \line Endet \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... Hoc iter ascendit si quis super ethera tendit Sic non offendit, celestis premia pendit. Amen. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Walther\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Initia 18305. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 H\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 \u246 \'f6\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 ver\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 S.19 Nr.34. \emdash Laut Initium auch in Cgm 809, Nr. 32d (39 Verse); Cgm 817, Nr. 7, Downside Abbey, Cath. Libr., 48245 (Clifton 4), f.258-261 (siehe \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Ker\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Oxford 1977, S. 463). Als 'Gradus humilitatis' verzeichnet bei \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Bloomfield\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Nr.5765 (im Initium \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs20 fortitudo dei\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 nach Kopenhagen, Ny. kgl. S.2949, f.2\endash 4b). }

\uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 1v\endash 4vb, 6rb\endash vb {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://bezwrk[0].6930/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Excerpta varia ecclesiastica}}\plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 De religiosis tria sunt memorabilia (?): Primo vite communitas scilicet in fraterna dileccione ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Exzerpte \u252 \'fcber die Lebensf\u252 \'fchrung. \emdash 1vb \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... Nonne reges et principes non plus habent nisi usum bonorum. \line >Urbanus< Item Urbanus papa: {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://5650[0].5666l/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Quicumque vestrum communem vitam susceptam habet, novit se nichil proprium habere}}\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 2ra\endash rb Gestrichene Texte (a) \u252 \'fcber den Dominikanerorden (?): \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Reverendissimus magister ordinis impetravit pro toto ordine a sanctissimo domino nostro iubileum remissionis omnium peccatorum ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (b) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Casus reservati pape, scilicet offense ecclesiastice libertatis ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 2rb Abla\u223 \'df f\u252 \'fcr den Karmeliterorden beim Lesen der Bu\u223 \'dfpsalmen \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Notum facientes qualiter sanctissimus pater et dominus noster dominus Sixtus quartus ... papa iubileum concessit die XXVIII Septembris 1475 pro toto ordine Carmelitarum, dummodo quilibet sciens legere dicat sex vicibus septem psalmos penitenciales. \line Si velles scripturarum ingredi veritatem, nunc peteres oracionibus nunc quereres in scripturis nunc pulsares bonis operibus ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 3vb unten: Di\u228 \'e4tetische Notiz \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Item herba que vocatur stainrei\u223 \'df: bonum est commedere contra calculum. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 2va\endash 3ra \u252 \'fcber Exkommunikation \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Queritur utrum participans cum excommunicato mortaliter peccet. Respondeo quod sic ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 2vb \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Excommunicacio minor excluditur a participacione sacramentorum ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 3rb\endash 4ra Guillelmus Parisiensis \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Wilhelmus Parisiensis de septem potissimis astuciis temptamenti dyaboli et processionibus quas ponit in libro suo de virtutibus quibus eciam sapientissimi et fortissimi deiciuntur: Prima astucia est longa fatigacio et vexacio de aliquo vel aliquibus peccatis ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... illud remedium multum approbant sancti etc. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 3v unten marginal \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Versus: Sex in lacte dies, ter sunt in sangwine terni / Bis seni carnem, ter seni membra figurant (i. 45) \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (auch in anderen Zeugen, vgl. 'In principio'). \line 4ra\endash rb und 4vb Beichtformeln \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Dominus noster Ihesus Christus per meritum sue passionis dignetur te absolvere et ego auctoritate ipsius et ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Eugenius IV. und Sixtus IV. sind genannt.) \line 4va Listen theologischer Begriffe nach ihrer Zahl geordnet \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Arbor virtutum theologicarum< Tres: Fides spes caritas. Quatuor: Prudencia temperancia ... Quinque sensus sicilicet visus ... Sex opera misericordie temporalia: cibare potare ... Septem peccata mortalia ... sacramenta ... dona spiritus sancti ... Octo beatitudines ... Nova peccata aliena scilicet iussio ... Decem precepta domini scilicet: Unum crede deum ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 4vb\endash 6rb Articuli condemnati (s.u.) \line 6rb Lebensalter \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Prima enim etas hominis dicitur infancia et durat usque ad VII annos. Secunda dicitur puericia usque ad XII vel XIIII. Tercia dicitur adolescencia usque ad XXV annos. Quarta iuventus vel virilis et durat ad L annos. Quinta senectus durat ad LXX annos. Sexta abinde et dicitur senium, aliarum etatum terminus. Sic et sex generaciones mundi: Prima usque ad Noe, secunda usque ad Abraham, tercia usque ad David, quarta usque ad transmigracionem Babilonis, quinta usque ad adventum Christi, sexta usque ad finem seculi. etc. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 6rb\endash va \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 In casu namque quo papa quid per surrepcionem precipit, non wlt quod impleatur ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Zitiert werden die Decretalen und die Glossa ordinaria. \line 6va\endash vb Augustinus \u252 \'fcber die Seele \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Unde Augustinus in sermone quodam quem facit de anime preciositate et valore sic inquid: Quia anima est vita racionalis et sensibilis vivificans spiritualiter et invisibiliter omnia viscera ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 6vb \u220 \'dcber die T\u246 \'f6chter des eitlen Ansehens \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Nota secundum Gregorium septem filie oriuntur de inani gloria. Prima est inobedientia. Nam ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u220 \'dcber den Schutzengel \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Nota melius est honorare proprium angelum quam aliquem sanctorum, quamvis sanctorum merita liberare nos possunt a penis purgatorii, sed a pena damni liberare non possunt. Sed angeli custodiant nos ab omni malo et perducant (!) preces nostras et alia bona que facimus in conspectum dei, quia nos indigni sumus. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash Rest der Spalte leer. \emdash 1475 auf 2rb erw\u228 \'e4hnt. }

Hec est prima virtus de qua commendatur Iob vir simplex ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 137va \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >De solitudine< Solitudo vera est abstrahere mentem a sollicitudine et occupacione accionum exteriorum, ab omni delectacione creaturarum ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 138ra \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >De contemplatione< Contemplacio vera est colleccio affeccionum et omnium virium anime ad cognoscendum cum delectacione et ammiracione mentis ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash 138vb \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... illis ymnidicis angelorum choris interesse, admisceri celestibus civibus, de eterna in conspectu dei incorrupcione semper gaudere. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Nachbemerkung (15 Zeilen) \u252 \'fcber H\u228 \'e4resie \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Argumentum false contemplacionis habet qui aliquid de deo vel de aliqua perfeccione cognoscit, cui sacre scripture veritas contradicit ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Nennt die \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Arrii \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 und \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Sabellii. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 138vb Liste von Horae \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Hora< Item in die Eligii confessoris signat hora diei VIII. In die Stephani martiris IX. ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 In die Luce ewangeliste X. In die Theodori martiris IX.}

\uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 141ra\endash 150vb {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://bezper[0].4100/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Albertus Magnus (Ps.)}}\plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 : {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://bezwrk[0].6930/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Tractatus de virtutibus}}\plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Magnus Albertus de virtutibus; primo de caritate ad deum< \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 141rb \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Caritas ad deum vera est quando cum omnibus viribus suis ardenter infudit se deo nullum commodum transitorium vel eternum querens in eo, sed ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Kapitel \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 De humilitate, De obediencia, De paciencia, Paupertas, Castitas, De abstinencia, De prudencia, De fortitudine, De iusticia, De temperancia, Compassio, Pax, De misericordia, De concordia, De constancia, De largitate, \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 149va \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Verus mundi contemptus est abrenunciare omnibus rebus temporalibus ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 150ra \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Vera maceracio carnis est cum aliquis sponte castigat corpus ieiuniis vigiliis ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Letztes Kapitel 150rb \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 De perseverancia \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... et manifestetur tota divina natura tua, quia michi dignatus has perfectas virtutes enarrare. Amen. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash Hier ohne Praefatio. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Alberti Magni Opera ed. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Bourgnet\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 37, S.447\endash 512. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Hain\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 476ff. u.a. \emdash Vgl. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Bloomfield\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Nr.5875. \emdash Explicit abweichend. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 150vb Augustinus: Excerptum \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Augustinus< Unde Augustinus: Dum infirmitatem nostre carnis timemus, anime negligemus; que caro si delicate nutritur, occidit spiritum teste Augustino. Sicut tineam lanam devorat ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (vgl. PL 40, c.1075) \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... Inclitus victor. semper augustus. cupide legum iuventuti< Imperatoriam maiestatem non solum armis decoratam ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash 1rb \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... gubernari (!). Datum XI. Kalendas Decembrias (!) Constantinopoli. domino nostro Iustiniano perpetuo augusto IIII. Const. (!) >Domni Iustin(iani) sacratissimi Augusti Institutionum seu elementorum liber primus incipit de iustitia et iure< Iustitia est constans et perpetua voluntas ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash Buch II beginnt 7v, III 23r, IV 34r. f.25r (Lagenbeginn) ist unbeschrieben, auf 25v beginnt Kapitel III 7 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >De successione liberorum< \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash Explicit 44rb \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Alioquin diligentior \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (dar\u252 \'fcber: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 legum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 )\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 scientia vobis ex latioribus degestorum (!) libris adventura. Amen. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (1ra\endash 44rb) Glossae anteaccursianae in Institutiones Iustiniani \emdash Erste Glosse 1ra oben (abgegriffen): \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Institutionum ... ca. I: Summatim de his tractando facile aditu(m) ... operare, ut ipse facilis aditus quodam modo ad ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (nicht lesbar) \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... pollicendo malis penam interminando. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Auf dem linken Rand: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 S ... quia diceret aliquis imperatori, qualiter hoc facis? Cum magis deberes studere in armis quam in legibus. Ad hoc respondet: Bene feci, quod ita leges composui et ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... emendavi et hunc ... librum fieri iussi. \f1\lang1033\fs24 / \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Obstrictum tradat, dominus iam desinit esse. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 / \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Emptor namque rei, dum desinit, incipit esse. \line nostro convertitur hec ipotheca more. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (2) In vierter Spalte neben die vorangehenden Verse eingetragen: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Si carta falsa sententia forte feratur, \uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 1ra\endash 60va {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://bezper[0].4100/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Mesu\u235 \'eb Iunior}}\plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 : {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://bezwrk[0].6930/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Grabadin (liber I)}}\plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >In nomine dei misericordis H. Iohannis Nazaren. Filii Mesue Grabadiu (!) medicinarum particularium incipit, quod est Grabadiu sufficientie medici< Inquit Iohannes Mesue: Sanat et cetera. Sanat solus longuores (!) deus et de fragilitatis solo producit in largitate sua medicinam benedictus gloriosus \u8230 \'85 \line >Eius invocatio< Replet igitur spiritus dei precepta hec misericordia gracia sua \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (zu \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 replet\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 am Rand: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 explicat\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 )\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 1rb I 1 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Summa prima de egritudinibus capillorum< \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , am Rand \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Incipit summa prima sectionis prime de medicinis capillorum. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Text \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Cura huius egritudinis est tres res. Prima est occupari circa capitis mundificacionem \u8230 \'85 \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 28ra I 2 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Explicit prima particula sectionis prime. Incipit secunda (!) particula sectionis secunde prime (!)< Girum celi solus fecit deus \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 donec curetur. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Von sp\u228 \'e4terer Hand \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Explicit practica mes\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 [ue]\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 cum addicione nova. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash Rest der Seite leer. \emdash Glossen (Zitate aus \u8218 \'82Almansor\rquote ), zahlreiche marginale Korrekturen. Ab f.51r Kapitel\u252 \'fcberschriften von sp\u228 \'e4terer Hand mit Tinte. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Vgl. Th. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Silverstein\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Medieval latin scientific writings in the Barberini collection (Chicago 1957) S.42f. zu Vat. Barb. Lat. 166, f. 49\endash 84v. Frankfurt, StuUB, Praed. 9, f.47rb (\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Powitz\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 ). Weitere Zeugen vgl. \u8218 \'82In principio\rquote . \emdash Zum Autor vgl. VL\u178 \'b2 VI 451\endash 453. LMA,VI 567f. (mit weiterer Lit.).}

\uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 61ra\endash 85va {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://bezper[0].4100/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Mesu\u235 \'eb Iunior}}\plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 :{\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://bezwrk[0].6930/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 De simplicibus medicinis (liber II Grabadin)}}\plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Incipit liber Hebe Mesue de simplicibus medicinis< In nomine dei misericordis cuius nutu sermo recepit graciam et doctrina perfectionem \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 cum hec determinabimus. >Distinccio capitulorum primi libri< Quatuor intencionum agregabimus (!) sermonem \u8230 \'85 \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 61rb Text \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Continet ergo liber iste primus XXVI capitula. Capitulum primum sermo \u8230 \'85< Dicimus quod medicina laxativa non est a re complexionali \u8230 \'85 \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 71rb Buch II \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Incipit liber secundus de medicinis solutivis in speciali< Protelavimus usque huc intencionem et modos rectificationum medicinarum \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 et confert utrisque fistulis et vulneribus fraudulentis. Dosis eius est a kiratis (!) v. (!) usque ad dragmas II. vel usque ad z.I. (!) >Explicit Hebemesue de siuplicibus (!) medicinis< \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Mit marginalen Korrekturen von der Hand des Schreibers. Noten einer anderen zeitgen\u246 \'f6ssischen Hand. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Auch in Vat. Barb. Lat. 166, f.1\endash 24v und Frankfurt, StuUB, Praed. 9, f.1ra (\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Powitz\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 ). Weitere Zeugen siehe \u8218 \'82In principio\rquote (auch mit dem Initium des Buches II). Druck: Opera divi Ioannis Mesue, s.l. 1541, fol. 41v.}

\uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 119ra\endash 147rb {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://bezper[0].4100/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Nicolaus (Salernitanus?)}}\plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 : {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://bezwrk[0].6930/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Antidotarius, doses et synonyma}}\plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Ego Nycholaus rogatus a quibusdam in practica studere volentibus, ut eos recto ordine modum dispensandi conficiendique docerem \u8230 \'85 \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 119va \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Aurea Alexandrina. Aurea dicta est ab auro, Alexandrina ab Alexandro \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Erste Glosse des Kommentars \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Aurea al. Opiata est usualis \u8230 \'85 \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 145ra Alphabetisches Verzeichnis (\u8218 \'82De quantitatibus\rquote oder \u8218 \'82Doses\rquote ): \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Carpobalsami uncias II. Gariofilorum uncias III \u8230 \'85 \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 145vc \u8218 \'82Synonyma\rquote \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Incipiunt synonima Antydotarii. Explicitis autem specierum que ad omnium supradictarum medicinarum confectionem pertinent ponderibus \u8230 \'85 Arthemesia idest matricaria / Achacia idest \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 Zinzeleon (?) idest quinque folium. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 / \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Explicit antydotarius Nycholai et doses et synonima eiusdem. Deo gracias. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Die \u8218 \'82Synonyma\rquote auch in Frankfurt, StuUB, 18, f.248ra. Weitere Zeugen vgl. \u8218 \'82In principio\rquote }

Israelita}}\plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 : {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://bezwrk[0].6930/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Viaticus peregrinantis Constantino Africano interprete cum glossulis Girardi}}\plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Vorwort \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Quoniam quidem ut in rethori\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 [ci]\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 s Tullius ait, Omne inquit expetendum vel propter se vel propter aliud vel propter utrumque expetitur \u8230 \'85 >Incipiunt glosule Giraudi< Quoniam quidem etc. Cum omne elementum et ex elementis corpus generatum \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 170va Kapitelverzeichnis Buch I, \line 170vb Buch I \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Capillus ex fumo grosso et calido nascitur \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 171va Kommentar \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Capillus etc. Premisso prohemio incipit a passionibus capillorum tanquam diligens actor, quas Rasy(s) et Avicenna penitus dimittunt \u8230 \'85 \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 189ra Buch II \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Superior particula capitis et cerebri infirmitates et curas continuit \u8230 \'85 \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 202rb Buch III \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 In duobus libris precedentibus tantummodo dictis infirmitatibus capiti et faciei pertinentibus \u8230 \'85 \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 215vb Buch IV \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Quoniam in tercio libro superiori morbos et medicinas membrorum spiritum serviencium diximus \u8230 \'85 \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 233ra Buch V \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Multis locis gloriosissimi medici digestibilem virtutem tria loca optinere dixerunt corporis \u8230 \'85 \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 251vb Buch VI \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Deus ad animalium genera existenda (!) creavit membra, unde essent procreanda \u8230 \'85 \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 265rb Buch VII \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Expletis in superiori particula interiorum membrorum curationibus \u8230 \'85 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash 288ra Ende des Textes \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 idem faciunt cepe cocte cum oleo rosato mixte et pistate valent similiter conche marine incense cum oleo rosato mixte ad idem multum valent. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 288rb Ende des Kommentars \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 \u8230 \'85 cum oleo rosato consolidare habent et mundificare. Similiter cepe et hoc valet in causa multiplicata (?). \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash Rest des Bl.288 ausgeschnitten, 288v leer. \emdash Mit interlinearen und marginalen Glossen einer sp\u228 \'e4teren Hand. Ab 186r Noten. 249rb eine Anmerkung dieser Hand mit deutschen Wort: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Hec descripcio huius avis satis videtur esse, avis que in theotunico wasserstelz dicitur et apud quosdam appellatur deceptrix pascorum. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Gedruckt Basel 1536. Zum Viaticus siehe \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Schuba\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 zu Vat. Pal. Lat. 1158, f.2ra\endash 68vb. Zum Kommentar des Girardus Bituricensis siehe \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Schuba\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 zu Vat. Pal. Lat. 1149,125ra; Pal. Lat. 1161 und Pal. Lat.1165.}

\uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 340ra\endash 377vb {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://bezper[0].4100/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Hippocrates}}\plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 : {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://bezwrk[0].6930/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Aphorismi cum commento Galeni interprete Constantino Africano cum comm. marginali}}\plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Auf oberem Rand \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Racio nil aliud quam distinctio (?) intelligibilium / de re dubia faciens fidem. / Dicit experimentum ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Prefacio domini Constantini Affricani Cassianensis monachi ad Glauconem discipulum suum: Licet peticionibus tuis continuis aquiescens (!) fili mi \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (nur Kurzfassung:) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Text des Hippocrates \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Vita brevis, ars vero longa. Tempus autem acutum, experimentum vero fallax, iudicium autem difficile. Oportet ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Kommentar des Galen \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Plurimi interpretes huius libri in hoc maxime sunt concordati, sive hoc sit unus amphorismus sive sint plures amphorismi ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Erste Marginalglosse \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Constantinus proponit intencionem (?) suam circa hunc librum de translacione eius ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 345rb Pars II \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 In quo morbo sompnus laborem prestat, mortale; si vero sompnus iuvat, non mortale ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Marginalglosse zum Anfang \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 In quo morbo etc.: Hec est secunda pars huius libri tocius et ponit ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , 351ra III, 355vb \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Explicit tertia particula amphorismorum Ypocratis cum commento Galieni, et incipit quarta eiusdem. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 363ra V, 368vb VI \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Explicit VIa particula amphorismorum, et incipit septima. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \line Endet 377vb Hippokrates \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... quanto magis dabuntur, tanto plus peiorabuntur. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Galenus \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... et non esse Ypocratica confirmare poterit. Explicit liber Amphorismorum Ypocratis cum commento Galieni fidelis interpretis sui Completus anno domini Millesimo Trecentisimo (!) in die Barnabe apostoli a Friderico. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash 339va Entwurf einer Liste der Aphorismi des Hippocrates. \emdash Unter den Glossen, die z.T. sehr umfangreich sind, auch Verse, z.B. 347r unten \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Humectant multus cibus et stimulus colerarum / Visque recentem virtutis debilitata ... (?) \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Vgl. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Schuba\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 zu Vat. Pal. lat. 1079, f.1ra\endash 48vb. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Thorndike/Kibre\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 1704.10, 1055.3 \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Diels\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Die Handschriften der antiken \u196 \'c4rzte, I 104f. \uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 403rb\endash 432va {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://bezper[0].4100/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Hippocrates}}\plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 : {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://bezwrk[0].6930/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 De regimine acutarum I\endash III cum commento Galeni et comm. marginali}}\plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Incipit liber regimenti acutarum cum commento eiusdem \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (scil. Galeni).\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Hippokrates \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Qui de egrotantium accidentibus in singulis egritudinibus tractantes pocius consensisse feruntur ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Galenus \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Illi qui sentencias de assidis relatas scripserunt in eo que scripserunt de accidentibus ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Marginalkommentar \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Reprehendit antiquos de m(?) artificiali tradicione in eo quod scripserunt non scribenda de ipsis accidentibus ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 412vb \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Explicit prima particula. Incipit secunda regimenti acutarum. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 422va \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Explicit secunda particula regimenti acutarum. Et incipit tertia particula eiusdem. Amen. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash Explicit des Hippokrates \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... sed his aliquando conveniens est. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Explicit des Galenus \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... et medicus indiget ut sciat eas omnes preter hoc quod infirmus dicat ei ipsas. Explicit tertia particula regimenti acutorum Ypocratis cum commento Galieni. Amen. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Rest von 432v leer (bis auf einige Noten) leer. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Siehe P.\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Kibre\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Hippocrates Latinus, in: Traditio 31 (1975) 99\endash 126. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Diels\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 (ed.), 1, 1905 S. 8f. (S.9 Hs. genannt). \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Thorndike/Kibre\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 1205.11. Galen: 660.1, 922.9. Auch in Vat. \uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 247va\endash 256rb {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://bezwrk[0].6930/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Canones paenitentiales et Casus papales et episcopales}}\plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 Que penitencia propter causas iniungenda, de hoc sunt diverse opiniones. Quidam enim dicunt, quod omnes penitencie ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 248rb \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Primus canon dicit, quod presbyter qui fornicacionem fecerit ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 248va \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Secundus canon dicit quod sacerdos cognoscens filiam suam spiritualem ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 usw. bis Kanon 46, danach 251va \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Quod presbiteri de occultiis tantum penitenciam dare possunt ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 251vb beginnt die Behandlung der im Inhaltsverzeichnis vorn genannten 'Casus papales et episcopales': \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... Sed in hiis casibus qui a iure vel conswetudine episcopo reservantur vel ad ipsum specialiter pertinere noscimur. Primus casus in solempni penitencia imponenda ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash 252ra \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... et sacramentis ecclesie. In nomine patris et filii et s.s. Amen. Attendens quid de Aricio licet insufficiens canonici iuris professor et de talibus (!) ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 252rb \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Dispensans episcopi (!) in adulteriis et in aliis criminibus ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 253rb \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Nota excommunicacio est a deo separacio et illa est semper timenda, quia ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 253rb \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Primo percussores clericorum cuiuscumque religionis sunt, quia quicumque clericum percusserit, excommunicatus est ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Beginnt eine durch 'Item' eingeleitete Aufz\u228 \'e4hlung von Casus, die sich bis 256rb erstreckt: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Item qui non volunt subesse racione (!) ecclesie ... Item qui cadunt in heresim ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... digne autem accedentibus sit laus et benediccio a domino deo. Quibus si aptans abstinuerunt tradimus in pignus unigenitum dei filium Ihesum Christum dominum nostrum, qui vivit et regnat in secula secula. Amen. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Rest der Seite und folgende Bl. leer. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 'Quae paenitentia sit pro peccatis': Melk, 1387, f.238r. Wilhering, IX 104, f.126v\endash 181: Quaestiones bonae et utiles ex Summa confessorum lib. III, tit. 34. \emdash 'Casus papales et episcopales' auch in Admont, 304, f.176\endash 178 mit dem Incipit \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs20 Primo percussores clericorum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 (hier 253rb).}

\uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 1r\endash 23v {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://bezper[0].4100/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Richardus de Bury}}\plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 : {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://bezwrk[0].6930/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Philobiblon}}\plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Incipit liber dictus Philobilon id est de amore librorum domini Richardi de Burgundia (!) episcopi Dimelinensis foeliciter< \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Vorrede 1r\endash 2r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Universis Christi fidelibus ... Richardus de Burg. (Burgundia) ... Dimelinensis episcopus salutem ... Quid retribuam domino pro omnibus que retribuit michi devotissime, investigat psalmista rex invictus ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... amabiliter nuncupare. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 2r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Capitulum primum de commendacione sapiencie et librorum in quibus sapiencia inhabitat< Thezaurus desiderabilis sapiencie et sciencie quem omnes homines per instinctum nature desiderant ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \line 23v Kapitel 20 endet mit \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... fruibilis faciei conspectum. Amen. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Liber Philobiblon idest de amore librorum dictus domini Richardi de Bur(gundia) episcopi Dimelinensis perpulcher per fratrem Mathiam Farinatoris de Wyenna ordinis fratrum beate dei genitricis virginis Marie de Monte Carmeli feliciter explicit, scriptus per eundem in alma universitate Erfordiensi anno domini 1473, in die sancti archangeli Michaelis finitus. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash Blatt 24 leer. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Edition: A. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Altamura\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Napoli 1954, 22, 71\endash 134}

Necesse est enim ut veniant scandala

Hec itaque omnia in quibus loquacior fortasse fui

Captacio est benevolencie< Reverendo domino ac genere preclaro domino Iohanni de Eberstein camerario Maguntino suus ubique clericus humilimus (!) Henricus Langenstein dictus de Hassia. Post mundana celestia, post Marthe sollicitudinem, Marie sororis requiem ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... hec non pretereunt tecum sed ad ethera vadunt etc. Deo gracias. \line Explicit hec nichili que pendit epistola mundi / Orbis edens facinus miserum variosque labores. H. de Hassia. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 In 10 Kapitel geteilt. \emdash 141r am Ende von Kap.4 marginal \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Versus ex Bernhardo Gestensi (!) \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 zu den zitierten Versen \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Ecce minaciter inminet arbiter ille supremus / Imminet imminet ut mala terminet equa coronet ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (aus Bernardus Morlanensis). \emdash Marginal zu Kap.5 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Nota hic de balneo Wysbaden apud Magunciam. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Bloomfield\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Nr.3965 (mit dieser Hs.). \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Kreuzer\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Heinrich von Langenstein, S.72 mit Anm.185. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Hohmann\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Initienregister, S.422 Nr.262}
De caelibatu sacerdotum ad Nicolaum papam (Praefatio)

Multi quidem in felicitate generis ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... illustrium factorum censor. >Declamande controversie tytulus de nobilitate< Etate illa florentissima qua vastum Rome imperium adolevit ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... in vestra nunc sententia relinquitur. >Explicit de nobilitate controversia< \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Ed. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Garin\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Prosatori latini del quattrocento ..., S.141\endash 165. \emdash \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Bertalot\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Initia II 891. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Bertalot\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Studien I 142\endash 144 Nr.99 (mit Parallel\u252 \'fcberlieferung und Kl\u228 \'e4rung der Verfasserfrage). Vgl. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Sottili\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Nr.4: Bamberg, SB, Class. 91, f.41r\endash 59v. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 229v Hugo Primas: Versus (XXIII 1\endash 5) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Dives eram et dilectus Inter pares preelectus Modo gravat me senectus Et etate sum confectus A deiectis sum deictus. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash Ohne Autor- oder Titelangabe. \emdash \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Walther\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , Initia 4618. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Langosch\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , Hymnen und Vagantenlieder..., 170. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 229v Schema de fine artis poeticae \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Omnis poeta aut scribit gracia delectacionis, utilitatis aut utriusque. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 / \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Si primum, hoc est duobus modis: Comici ... Tragici ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 / \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Si secundum sic sunt satirici ... finis illorum est radicitus vicia extirpare ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 / \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Gracia utriusque dicuntur hystoriaci, quia hystorias ut facta elegantissime fabulis describunt, ut Virgilius, Claudianus}

Agrorum enim dominium gentes ceperat, non domorum. \line Obsequiosa promptitudine ... aggredior. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (2) 233r\endash 238v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Compendium sew distigium in Anticlaudianum Alani< Magister Alanus peritus quondam in multis scienciis quendam auctorem compilavit bene quatuor milium versuum vel plus, quem Anticlaudianum nominavit ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... et de manu mortis liberavit populum suum et in regnum suum captivam duxit capitivitatem, cuius regni non erit finis in secula seculorum. Amen. >Explicit compendium universale Alani in Anticlaudianum< \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Vgl. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Ochsenbein\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , ZfdA 98 (1969) 81\endash 109, Text 93\endash 109; VL\u178 \'b2 3, 2\endash 4 ('Compendium Anticlaudiani'). \emdash (1) Initium entspricht den 'Mythologiae' des Fulgentius. In Frankfurt, StuUB, Ms. Praed. 22, f.485v. London, BL, Royal 12 E.XI, f.110. Budapest, Orsz\u225 \'e1gos Sz\u233 \'e9ch\u233 \'e9nyi K\u246 \'f6nyvt\u225 \'e1r, 420, f.1 u.a., siehe 'In Principio'. \emdash (2) Siehe \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Ochsenbein\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 . \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 238v Pilatus (Ps.): Epistola ad senatores urbis Rome \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Epistola quam scripsit Pilatus senatoribus urbis Rome de domino nostro Ihesu Christo.< >Et habetur in antiquis hystoriis libro 22 tractata (!) 2\plain \f1\i\super\lang1033\fs24 a\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 hystoriographarum (!)< Poncius Pilatus Claudio salutem. Nuper accidit quod et ipse probavi Iudeos per invidiam in se suosque posteros crudeli dampnacione premissa (!) ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... nequis aliter menciatur et existimet credendum mendaciis Iudeorum. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash Bl. 239r\endash 240v leer. \emdash Druck: \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Tischendorf\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , Evangelia apocrypha, Leipzig 1876, 413\endash 416. Postea 14 die eiusdem mensis fuit coniunccio Iovis et Veneris in 2\u176 \'b0 gradu libre ... \line Quid sit cometa. Dico cum philosopho quod cometa sit exalacio terrestris sicca et calida ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 256v Deutungen \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Significacionem eius dividam in quatuor differencias. Quarum prima continebit in quibus provinciis eius contiget effectus et operacio ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash Schlie\u223 \'dft \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Item anno domini 538 apparuit cometa ... ex simili causa et hec fieri possunt. Item sol ad hoc confert influenciam suam etc. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Thorndike\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Some tracts..., 237 n. 43. Vgl. Clm 18770}

Nota quod volente domino Paulus adhuc in carne existente (!) venit cum beato Michaele archangelo ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (6) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Nota de septem capitalibus viciis versus: Lux. ava. super. ac. invidus ira gula ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 127v (7) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Tria inveniuntur in deo tamquam puero nato ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 128r (8) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Nota quod regnum dei tripliciter queritur ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (9) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Nota quod ultimum iudicium erit horribile ex omni parte, quia supra nos erit iudex strennuus, subtus ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 128v (10) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Nota quod reprobi usque ad diem iudicii vident gloriam sanctorum ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 129r (11) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Nota de sompno quod triplex est sompnus, scilicet nature ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 und anderes beim J\u252 \'fcngsten Gericht. \line 130v (12) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Nota quod multi vadunt ad ecclesiam, non tamen omnes recta intencione querunt deum. Primi sunt superbi ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (13) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Nota quod triplex est gaudium ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 131r (14) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Misericordes esse debemus ad tria, primo ad deum ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 131v (15) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Sunt quedam genera piscium, scilicet angwille ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (16) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Sciendum propter quinque causas corporales contingunt infirmitates ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 132r (17) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Tres sunt hominis vie, scilicet spinosa lubrica (idest glat vel schlipfferigk) et tenebrosa ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (18) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Nota tres sunt hostes anime ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 132v (19) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Nota quod triplex est mala corona ... \line Moraliter: Nota quod quilibet homo positus est in hoc mundo sicut signum ad sagittam. Et sunt quatuor a quibus sagittamur ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 133r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Nota quare dominus dederit claves regni celorum et non inferni ... \line Quinque sunt raciones quare dignitates non sunt appetende ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Die restlichen Eintr\u228 \'e4ge unter \u220 \'dcberschriften: 133v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 De primis parentibus, \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 134r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Tribus generibus hominum clamavit deus, De mulieribus euntibus ad ecclesiam, De ascensione domini, \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 134v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 De sancta Maria, De dileccione dei erga nos, \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 135r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 De stulticiis: Nota multe sunt stulticie, quibus homines in bello spirituali succumbunt ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 135v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Quod deus tria docuit \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... Sed stultus est qui videt aliquem ardentem, et inde non erit caucior. Refert Valerius ad Ruffinum, quod pannicius (!) venit ad vicinum suum flens et conquestus est dicens: Arborem infelicem in orto meo habeo ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Nr.22) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Hystoria quod dyabolus invidet nostris bonis operibus. Reffert Plinius quod est quedam arbor in India ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Endet 143v Nr.38, 39. 144r Nr.47: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Hystoria de accidia seu pigricia. Legitur parabolice de quodam rege tres filios habente ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... metu territus inferni tormentorum. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Expliciunt moralitates magistri Roberti Holckot Angli et ordinis predicatorum cum aliquibus annexis et interpositis, non pluribus seu multis, sed tantum in uno medio folio, videlicet in ultimo primi sexterni post hystoriam seu gradum de ingratitudine scilicet (?) de septem gestibus Ihesu Christi in cruce benedicta. etc. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Palmer\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Das 'Exempelwerk der englischen Bettelm\u246 \'f6nche', S.170 Liste (mit dieser Hs., ohne die folgenden 'Imagines' zu nennen)}

\uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 145r\endash 156v {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://bezwrk[0].6930/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Notae theologicae, excerpta et quaestiones}}\plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Nota quod si vis esse lucrator et supplantator viciorum, debet in te esse primo ars fructuosa cautissime operacionis ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (mit einem Zitat aus Vegetius); 146r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Opera nature sunt tria, scilicet creacio in qua dei potencia debet excogitari ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (mit Psalmenzitat); 146v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Certamen. Bernhardus: Tres hostes habeo quos vincere non valeo, mundum carnem et dyabolum ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Quaestiones 147v\endash 148r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Utrum per quendam consuetudinem possit derogari statuto generalis synodi ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 und \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Utrum vetus lex permitteret peccatum cordis ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Rest von 148r leer. \line 148v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Abusiva seculi sunt XII scilicet sapiens sive predicator sine operibus ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 149v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Notandum quod sunt tria propter que seculares et mundane viventes detrahunt religiosis ... Nota quod quedam muliercule per sathanam seducte illusionibus et fantasmatibus credunt ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 150v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Quatuor sunt naturales mentis affecciones, dolor et gaudium, de presenti timor et spes de futuro ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 151r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Nota quod triplex est convivium, quod celebrat sapiencia ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 151v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Domus anime eterni regis oppidum est, sed obsessum ab inimicis ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... Bernhardus in sermone domini \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Bernardus Claraevallensis, In dedicatione ecclesiae sermo III 1). \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Castrum anime in terra inimicorum situm est, undique impugnatur, ideo ex omni parte muniendum est ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Bernardus Claraevallensis, Sermo de diversis 82, 2). Quo ingressus ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash 113r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... pro peccatis nostris quoniam ad hoc natus ipse et datus est nobis. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Einige S\u228 \'e4tze \u252 \'fcbersprungen.\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Nr.4) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Non est dubium quicquid in laudibus proferemus ad filium pertinere ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash 119r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 \emdash ... specialiter fiat michi secundum verbum tuum. Si peccavi quod propriam magis excitavi \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (!)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 devocionem ... cui hic \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (!)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 meum qualecumque opusculum devotissime destinavi. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Schlu\u223 \'dfgebet: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Deus qui nos a seculi vanitate eversos ad superne vocacionis amorem accendis ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash 119r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... promittere pertingamus. Qui vivis et regnas deus. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Gedruckt: Opera 4, ed. \uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 162v\endash 165v {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://bezwrk[0].6930/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Problemata arithmetica}}\plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Nota hic per denarios proiectiles facile est addere subtrahere dupplicare et dimidiare ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash 163r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... istis notatis sunt ponende alique regule per quas expedientur questiones per numerum facte. \line Et est prima regula de tri (!) apud Ytalicos qui eciam eandem regulam nominant auream regulam, et vocatur apud philosophos regula proposicionum ... \line Secunda regula est mercatorum que elucebit in hac questione: Sunt tres mercatores facientes unam societatem; quorum primus imponit 36 floridos ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Gesellschaftsrechnung vgl. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Vogel\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Nr.199). \line \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Tercia regula vocata est de usura que clarebit in hoc exemplo: Sunt tres mercatores quorum primus imponit 20 floridos per tres menses ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (vgl. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Vogel\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Nr.199) \line 164r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Quarta regula est de lepore. Hec videlicet: Quidam lupus fugitivus ad silvam in minuto huius hore transivit XII passus; persecutus est eum velter ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Verfolgungsaufgabe siehe \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Vogel\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Nr.33 mit S.223 \u167 \'a734 sowie S.214 \u167 \'a718: eine 'Regula de lepore fugiente' sp\u228 \'e4ter bei Georgius de Hungaria). \line \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Alia regula: Quidam vadit ad Romam cottidie ambulans septem miliaria, illum persequitur equus ... \line Alia regula de est dicta de pipere et figuratur in hac questione: Quidam paterfamilias dicit suo famulo ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Es folgen weitere Regulae und Textaufgaben, als letzte 165v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Alia regula: Quidam agonisavit, ne intestatus decederet, hoc modo ordinavit suum testamentum: Uxor mea baiulat ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... et sic adimpleta est patris intencio. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (\u228 \'e4hnlich \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Vogel\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , Nr.209 mit S.176 und 223 \u167 \'a732). \line Die einzelnen Aufgabentexte finden sich nur \u228 \'e4hnlich, nicht aber wortgleich in der Edition Vogels. \line \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Si vis virgam visoriam ubique terrarum ex arte (?) confitere (!). \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Zu dieser Bemerkung \u252 \'fcber den Visierstab siehe \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Thorndike\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , Some little known astronomical and mathematical manuscripts, Osiris 8 (1949) 43. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Thorndike\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 1132. Kurt \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Vogel\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 : Die Practica des Algorismus Ratisbonensis, M\u252 \'fcnchen 1954, passim}

Primo ergo de modo diversimode predicandi ubi videbitur quale thema accipi debeatur et qualiter acceptum et ad propositum deducatur. Secundo de modo ipsum thema dividendi ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 bis \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Sextum capitulum erit ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 183v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Nunc videndum est de secundo scilicet de modo dividendi ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash Endet unvollst\u228 \'e4ndig \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... quia primo describitur ut utilis quia lux enim (?) est. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash f.188 leer. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Vgl. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Charland\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Artes praedicandi, S.103; \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Caplan\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Medieval Artes praedicandi, I 22 Nr.119, je mit dieser Hs., und II 119}

Et dicitur ab alle quod est narrate et lu quod est laudem et ia quod est domino quasi narrate laudem domino, iuxta illum versum 'Alle narrate lu laudem ia dominoque' ..., \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 weitere Formen von Merkversen zu Alleluia \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Alle salvifica lu me ia sit tibi Christe, All lux le virtus, sed luia vita vocatur \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 u.a., dann Erkl\u228 \'e4rungen der W\u246 \'f6rter 'Alpha et O', 'Ihesus', 'Christus' u.a., \line 246v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Sequitur capitulum secundum< Sequitur de istis que sunt defecta verbalia; prius fuerit determinativum de illis que fuerunt defecta mistice posita ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 249r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Post videndum est formalis declinacio verborum supinorum ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 254r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... salve formare decebit. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 254r\endash 255r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Nota regulas de construccione quarum prima talis est quod omnes declinabiles partes ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... quinto: cum infinitivo ut volo legere. \emdash Glosa nominum et verborum defectivorum\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 im Inhaltsverzeichnis vorn.\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Vgl. Ad propositum ergo status diviciarum depingebatur ut mulier vaga in signum fragilitatis et inconstancie et mutabilitatis ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Imag. Fulg. Nr.9). \line 256r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Fulgentius libro de contemptu mundi ponit ymaginem vanitatis in hunc modum scilicet puellam wltu pulcram et placabilem, induta rethe ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Imag. Fulg. Nr.11). \line 256v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Narrat Hysiderus cupiditatem esse deum amoris qui est demon formicacionis ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Imag. Fulg. Nr.12). \line 256v\endash 257v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Theodosius de vita Alexandri: Rex Sicilie Alexandrum ad convivium invitavit et quid sibi conferre posset sollicitus cogitavit ... fecit eum sedere inter 4\plain \f1\i\super\lang1033\fs24 or\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ducissas que fuerunt pulcherrime mulierum ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... in aspectu alicuius mulieris pulcherrime. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Holkot. mor. 1). \line 257v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Commentator Iuvenalis super illud 'Descendit de celo Nohisolites (!)' dicit quod oraculum Appollinis fuit Nohisolites idest nosce te ipsum ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Holkot. mor. 2)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 258r-259v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Tulius in Achademicis questionibus questione 4a commendat Varronem eo quod ipse tradidit iura deorum ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... verecundia. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Holkot. mor. 3). \line 259v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Legitur in hystoriis Grecorum, quod Sardanapulus rex Grecie (!) ita incontinens fuit quod in sepulchro suo fecit scribi istum versum ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Holkot. mor. 4). \line 260r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Secundum Fulgencium et Hysiderum (!) ymago amoris: Scriptura prime ale talis erat Verus amor est fortis et magne virtutis ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Holkot. mor. 6). \line 261v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Ymago penitencie quam descripserunt sacerdotes dee Veste depingebatur ad modum unius hominis ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 262r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Fertur in libro deorum quod Socrates depinxit ymaginem superbie coronatam tribus coronis ad ostendum, quod superbus omnibus wlt dominari ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (vgl. Carpentras, BM [Inguimbertine], 119, f.76 \u228 \'e4hnlich: superbus odiendus). \line 262v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Narrant hystorie quod fuit quidam miles qui fecit proclamare hastiludium et ipse amore cuiusdam domine hastiludiavit ... Ad propositum: Iste miles est filius dei ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 263v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Pinxerunt pagani tot esse deos quot virtutes. Appollo autem proprietate depingebatur ad similitudinem unius hominis qui tenebat in manu sua cor scissum ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 264r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Legitur in hystoria Atheniensium quod quidam nobilis deliquit (!) contra suum regem; in cuius transgressionem precepit rex ipsum et omnes sibi affines exulari. Contigit autem filium regis ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 265r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Narrat Plinius ad Maximum (!) quod inter Romanos erat quedam retroversio (!) et discensio (!) de quibusdam famosis, quis diceretur esse principalis et quis eius titulus ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Holkot. mor. 15). \line 266r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Legitur quod apud gentiles in quadam civitate erat dedicata dea fortune, Cant. V\u176 \'b0: Fontes in medio; ad quos cum illi de civitate et predicta dea aliquid impetrare vellent, miserunt quinque virgines pulchras ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Syntax verdorben)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Holkot. mor. 12?). \line 267r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Refert Tytus Linus (!) quod Rome inventa fuit una mensa aurea et consulabatur Appollo quibus esset danda et respondit quod sapiencie, et tunc respondit: Date Taleto (!) ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Holkot. mor. 13). \line 267v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Scribe quod pro fallaciis fortune transeuntis et illa que sunt pro misteriis vite presentis ... est una figura quam tangit beatus Augustinus 8. de civitate dei de chymera ... Quidam autem miles chimeram istam devicit ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Holkot. mor. 16?). \line 269r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Dea Veste depingebatur cum libro quinque folia habens et in quolibet folio scribebatur versus ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Holkot. mor. 18). \line 269v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Legitur quod sunt quidam pisces in mari qui vocantur delphines; hy voces hominum ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Holkot. mor. 20). \line 269v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Narrat Plinius quod inter philomenam et bubonem est odium animale ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Holkot. mor. 23). \line 270v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Narrat Ovidius de transformatis quod tres fuerunt Syrene in quadam insula ... Cum vero Ulixes inde transsiret (!) ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Holkot. mor. 27). \line 271v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Legitur secundum Remigium in annalibus Iudeorum quod erat quidam (!) domina adamata a 4\plain \f1\i\super\lang1033\fs24 or\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 regibus ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Holkot. mor. 28). \line 271v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Refert Romulus in annalibus Iudeorum quod quedam domina preventa amoris magnitudine dominum proprium repudiavit et altera (!) conglutinata est in amore ... misit sibi 4\plain \f1\i\super\lang1033\fs24 or\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 annulos aureos ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Holkot. mor. 29). \line 272v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Beatus Bernhardus vidit hominem stantem super unum puteum, scintillas de puteo exeuntes devorantem ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Holkot. mor. 31). \line 272v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Refert Ieronimus contra Iovinianum quod Dyogenes ita perfectus erat in paupertate, quod dolium habebat pro domo ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (mit Alexander)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Holkot. mor. 32). \line 273r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Nota quod non est desperandum pro quocumque peccato vili et horribili quia dicit Ieronimus: Deus paratus est salvare clemencia quos non potest salvare iusticia. Unde refert Romulus in annalibus Iudeorum quod erat quidam tyrannus qui captus et invacuatus in amore cuiusdam domine ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Holkot. mor. 33). \line 274v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Narrat Solinus de mirabilibus mundi quod in India erat unus mons magnus et altus et in illo monte erat fons ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Holkot. mor. 34). \line 275r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Legitur in cronicis quia anno ab urbe Romana condita 23 populus Romanus columpna in fero (!) Romana statuit et ibi statuam Iulii Cesaris statuerunt ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Holkot. mor. 35). \line 275v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Narrat Valerius libro 4 de Alexandro Magno qui esset homo magnus et nobilis, habuit tamen tres pessimas condiciones ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Holkot. mor. 36). \line 276r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Narrat Romulus in annalibus Iudeorum quod in India fuerunt tres leges, prima fuit quod rex semel in anno deberet ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Holkot. mor. 37). \line 277r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Depingitur domina (!) Fortune secundum Ovidium in fallaciis fortune habere in manu sinstra tres flores ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Holkot. mor. 38). \line 277r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Adulacio depingebatur in una manu habere speculum, in alia vero obtulit poculum delicatum ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Holkot. mor. 39). \line 278r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Secundum Ovidium de arte amandi amor efficit redamantes unanimes in honore ... Trayanus Helenam depinxit deam amoris circumrotatam 4or rotis ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Holkot. mor. 41). \line 278r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Legitur quod in castello Emaus fuit quidam puer natus qui ab umblico et rursum (!) divisus erat, ita ut duo pectora, duo capita ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Holkot. mor. 43). \line 278v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Refert Boecius de consolacione libro 4\u176 \'b0, quod dum quidam miles Ulixes nomine cum sociis rediret de bello Troyano ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Holkot. mor. 44). \line 278r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Narratur in gestis Romanorum quod Romulus cinxit civitatem muro voluitque in ea regnare ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Holkot. mor. 45). \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... dominium habebit sicut Romulus de civitate Romana. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Aus dem 'Exempelwerk der englischen Bettelm\u246 \'f6nche' zitiert: a) Robertus Holkot, Moralitates, und b) Imagines Fulgentii, siehe Nigel F. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Palmer\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Exempelwerk, S.159\endash 163}

\uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 280r\endash 283r {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://bezwrk[0].6930/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Moralitates}}\plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Christus est flos secundum illud Ego flos campi< Ego flos campi et lilium convallium, Cant. V \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Ct 2,1)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . De isto flore potest exponi illud quod scribitur in libro de Enigmatibus idest obscuris questionibus regine Sabba ad regem Salomonem, ubi dicitur quod predicta regina volens experiri sapienciam Salomonis ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 280v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >De illo qui patrem et matrem verbo vel facto offendit, Exod. 51< Recitat Alfonsus in suo libro, quod fuit unus pater qui habuit tres filios de quibus sciebat quod unus erat legittimus ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 281r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Presentibus debet homo benefacere et ipsis in necessitatibus subvenire; qui contrarium faciunt non sunt digni hereditatem (!) in presenti nec in futuro< Legitur in libro de naturis rerum de pellicono (!) qui dum conspicit suos pullos a serpente venenatos ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 281r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Nota quod aliquis privatur hereditate paterna, si habet societatem cum malis viris< Petrus Alfonsus recitat de quodam domino unius civitatis qui tres filios habebat et cogitavit dimittere dominium civitatis uni illorum qui melius et comodius posset regere civitatem ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 281v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Qualiter virgo Maria peperit et virgo permansit< Inexpectabile est quod virgo pariat manens; cum videtur michi quod fuit sic de partu virginis lapidis unionis (!) dicitur enim in libro de naturis rerum quod apud insulam Capuam (!) est quidam lapis qui dicitur Unio ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Syntax!)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 282r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Diligere debemus deum ex toto corde< Difficile est deum diligere ex toto corde. Est tamen unus modus quo potest fieri. Exemplum: Falco est avis multum volatilis et magnicordis qui wlt volare ad omnia que videt. Propter quod dominus ponit capucium ante oculos eius ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 282v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >De penitencia< Penitencia habet in labore compendium virtuosum sicut bene patuit in latrone qui statim post penitenciam audire meruit: Hodie mecum eris in paradiso, Luc. 23. Quod pertractans Crisostomus in libro de reparacione lapsi dicit ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... et in die vindicte disperdet te}
