\uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 288v\endash 291r {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://bezwrk[0].6930/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Notae theologicae}}\plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >De misericordia domini< Divina misericordia potest acquiri per quatuor, primo per viam ... \line >De misericordia qualiter amittitur< Nota quod quatuor modis ammittitur divina misericordia, primo per viam rebellacionis ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 289r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Quibus est facienda misericordia< Nota ... dicitur quod sunt quatuor status mundi, primus est in celesti patria ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 289r\endash 290r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >De decimis< Decime debentur ex precepto reddere (!); unde Malachie III ... Decimas debemus dare multis de causis ... ... et ideo caute de hoc est predicandum. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 290r\endash 291r De tribulatione \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Cum ipso sum in tribulacione< Bernhardus super versum Psalmi: Cum ipso sum in tribulacione. Bonum est michi tribulari tecum, dum ipse sis mecum, quam regnare sine te et ... Geraldus de Fracheto de monitis (?): Baro quidam fuit nobilis genere, dives possessione ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... ut possis effugere istam penam; quod et factum est. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 291rv Moralisatio hydropici \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >De ydropico< {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://5650[0].5666l/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Ydropicus quatuor condiciones habet: Est enim sitibundus, inflatus, gravis, incurvatus}}\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... dicente Ieronimo \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (epist. 53,11)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 : Facile contempnit omnia qui semper cogitat se se moriturum. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 291v\endash 292r Moralisatio cordis humani \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Cor est simile terre et celo< Nos videmus quod cor humanum naturaliter ab amore et desiderio rerum non potest quiescere ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... congregatis}

\uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 297rv {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://bezwrk[0].6930/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Exempla aus einer dominikanischen Sammlung}}\plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >De virtute oracionis dominice< Laycus quidam interrogavit magistrum Iordanem dicens: Valetne Pater noster tantum in ore nostro sicut in ore clericorum? ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Uppsala, UB, C 203, f.177). \line \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >De castitate< Quedam pulchra mulier venit ad quendam fratrem Hispanum ... \emdash ... sed nec in vestimentis eius ullum erat combustionis vestigium. \line >De virtute oracionis< {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://5650[0].5666l/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Ffrater quidam Theutunicus a puericia consuevit habere passionem Christi in magna reverencia}}\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 et singulis diebus dicebar Adoramus ... \line >De beata virgine< Quidam frater consueverat venerari in beata virgine cor eius, quo Christum credidit et ipsum amavit, uterum eius, quo ipsum portavit ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 297v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >De differentibus subvenire defunctis< {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://5650[1].5666l/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Ffrater Matheus lector et predicator devotus post decem dies defunccionis sue fratri oranti apparuit dicens}}\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... \line >De hospitalitate< Quidam hospes fratrum cum permultos annos reciperet fratres et nulli ex eis vellet confiteri ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... hospes dixit quod haberet in celis premium et ipse nichilominus liberatus esset. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Vgl. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Welter\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , S.482).}

\uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 297v\endash 313v {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://bezwrk[0].6930/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Excerpta ex libro De habundantia exemplorum}}\plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Incipit excerptum de habundancia exemplorum. Et primo de paciencia< Iob qui amissis bonis suis dicebat Dominus dedit etc. Exemplum Gregorii in dyalogo: Stephanus servus dei cum die quadam messem quam propria manu serverat (!) ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 298r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >De paupertate< {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://5650[0].5666l/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Stibo (!) cum omnibus bonis amissis evasisset de incendio}}\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Es folgen zahlreiche Exempla unter den Rubriken: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 De difficultate restitucionis, De bonitate misse, Exemplum de fatuitate, De qualitate penarum futurorum (!), De carnalitate, De visione dei, Antiquitus homines non accipiebant uxores ante XXm annum, Contra malos iudices, De gravitate inferni et dulcedine paradysi, De multitudine penarum \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 usw., 301v wird ein \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 magister Iohannes Cardinalis \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 erw\u228 \'e4hnt unter dem Titel \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Contra differentes penitenciam. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Den Abschlu\u223 \'df bilden drei Exempla 'de usuris' 313rv, deren letztes lautet: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Rex quidam cum iaceret in extremis et vidisset camisiam sibi factam et advertens quod de omnibus diviciis nichil sequeretur eum ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... et peccata emendet. Ad idem \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Abbruch).\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Anscheinend nicht aus Humbertus de Romanis, Tractatus de dono timoris: \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Kaeppeli\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , SOP, Nr.2012 (gedr. als Ps.-Albertus Magnus, \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Hain\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 484, GW 581)}

\uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 182v\endash 187r {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://bezwrk[0].6930/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Notabilia et dubia quae in missa occurrunt}} \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (1) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Item nota aliqua notabilia necnon dubia que plerumque in missa occurruntur< >Primum dubium, cum sacerdos in missa per infirmitatem aliqua impeditur< Sciendum secundum Thomam de Aquino periculis sive defectibus circa sacramentum altaris evenientibus dupliciter potest occurri. Uno modo preveniendo ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Dubia \u252 \'fcber \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >comestio, de musca vel aranea (in calice), de aqua, de rubeo vino, de indebita hostia, de verbis obsecrationis ..., De effusione calicis< \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 usw., 186r Zitat aus Iohannes Gerson (cancellarius Parisiensis); 8 Merks\u228 \'e4tze: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Hec Bonaventura cardinalis et doctor egregius docet fore observanda a quolibet sacerdote celebraturo< Intencionis discussio nec celebret propter vanam gloriam ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 186v (2) Verse \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Fructus eukaristie< \line Hostia sacrificat, sociat cibat, et cibus iste / Restaurat saciat. delectat roborat auget ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 / \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Ideo< \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (3) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Presbiter in mensa domini quid agas bene pensa / Aut tibi vita datur aut mors eterna paratur. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (4) Ministranten \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Pro ministrantibus sacerdoti ad missam< Si servire cupis altari respice caute Presbiterum, calicem, lumen et esto vigil. Non procumbe, sed erecto stes pauca silenter Ora presbitero, stringe sonantem sonum Cum pausat pausa, librum circumfer et apta. Vina probes et aquam fundas ut ipse velit. Eice raro, tussim preme, muscas agitato. Non stes in faciem nec paciaris idem. Te prior exhibeas vel promptus esto petenti Sed magis ignotis, tunc bene gratus eris. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (5) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Alia metra de digne sumentibus< Mitigo (temptaciones) augeo (graciam) miceo (!) (minori reddo) terreo reprimo purgo \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 / \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Igneo lumino dupplico firmo duco propinquo \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 / \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Et vitam dono, tot mense fercula pono. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (6) Zitat aus Guillelmus Duranti \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Nota quo ornatu sit utendum quolibet tempore secundum quod ponit Gwilhelmus in Racionali< \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Endet 187r wiederum mit Versen (7) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Huc si declines Christum laudando placare \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 / \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Hortor festines prius hec tibi scripta notare \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 / \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Ut laus reddatur divina placens via munda \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 / \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Sincopa tollatur discordia mens vagabunda \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 / \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Error verborum simul et confusio morum. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 / \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Erigis et sanis est sana refeccio panis, \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 / \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Sed Christus panis non est sanus nisi sanis. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash Rest der Seite leer. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 (1) Exzerpte \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs20 De periculis que contingunt circa sacramentum eucharistiae\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 in Darmstadt, HLB, 675, f.175v\endash 181v (IV Nr.98), Graz, UB, 231, f.14v. \emdash (3) Auch in Br\u252 \'fcnn, UK, Mk 86 (II.39), f.7r. \emdash (4) Auch in Graz, UB, 677, f.1 und Uppsala, UB, C 19, f.313. \emdash (5) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs20 Augeo mitto mitigo terreo reprimo purgo\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 in mehreren Zeugen in Uppsala (siehe 'In principio'). \emdash (7) Als 'Versus in ecclesia scribendi' in Clm 14634, f.2r. }

Renuncciacio vero est proprie rei vel iuris spontanea refutacio. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash Rest der Seite leer, 337r Texte von anderer Hand (s.u.). \line 337v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >De dotibus< Nunc de dote dicendum restat. Si igitur res eximia ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... non solute et non tradite quantitatis. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Siehe L. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Sighinolfi\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Salatiele e la sua 'Ars notariae', in: Studi e memorie per la storia dell'Universit\u224 \'e0 di Bologna 4 (1920) 67\endash 149 (Einleitung der Redaktion I). Ausgabe: Gianfranco \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Orlandelli\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Ars notarie, Mailand 1961, II p. 27\endash 196 et 320 (Band II nicht eingesehen), zum Textbeginn vgl. Band I. Anonyme Ars notariae mit entsprechendem Initium in Freiburg, UB, Hs. 1154, f.13r\endash 14r, und G\u246 \'f6ttweig, Stift, K 33 (168, 184), f.165r\endash 174r (Katalog S.387). Paris, BN, lat. 14622, lat. 4593. Zum Autor vgl. auch P. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Weimar\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Art. 'Salathiel' im 'Lexikon des MAs'. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 337r {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://bezwrk[1].6930/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Epistola ex bursa Misnensi}}\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Cum pie sinceritatis affectu salutem plurimam. Reverende magister. Hesterno vesperi cum sol vergeret ad occasum ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... Valete, et me inter servulos vestros non mediocrem habete. Ex Bursa Misnensi die Saturni. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Auch in Clm 14125, f.195va (vgl. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Sottili\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ). Von Samuel Karoch? \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 337r Epistola ('Rem iam memorie') \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Rem iam memorie omnium michi iocundissimam, suavissime amice, quam ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... explicare. Vale et ut me soles ama. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Auch in Clm 14125, f.195vb\endash 196ra. Von Samuel Karoch?}

\uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 338r\endash 342v {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://bezwrk[0].6930/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Notariatst\u252 \'fccke betreffend Iohannes Lang (1468)}}\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \line (1) 338r\endash 339r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 In nomine domini. Amen. Anno a nativitate eiusdem millesimo quadringentesimo sexagesimo octavo indictione prima pontificatus sanctissimi ... patris ... Pauli ... pape secundi anno eius quarto die quarta Ianuarii hora vesperarum vel quasi presentia personaliter constitutus discretus vir Iohannes Lang clericus Augustensis. \line In nomine domini ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 lautend wie oben, doch \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 die vero lune IIII mensis Februarii \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (verbessert zu \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Ianuarii\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u252 \'fcber der Zeile)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 hora vesperarum vel quasi pontificatus ... Pauli ... pape secundi anno eius IIII\u176 \'b0 in domo dicte Der Malerin in platea Castri (?) sita in stuba hyemali pie (?) in opido Lipzg Merseburgensis diocesis in mei notarii publici testiumque infrascriptorum ... presencia personaliter constitutus dictus honorabilis vir dominus Lang rector parochialis in Kesingen Augustensis diocesis, dominus Iacobus Schonefelder clericus coniugatus Merseburgensis diocesis habens et tenens in suis manibus quasdam litteras autenticas sibi per nobilem virum dominum Porphirium de Erkingen alias Fidenneger \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (unten dann \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Seidenneger\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 )\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 comitem palatinum concessas ... Quarum litterarum tenor per omnia sequitur et est talis: Porphirius filius et heres legitimus quondam domini Iohannis de Erkingen (?) alias Seidenneger civis imperialis civitatis Constanciensis ... comes palatinus ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Erw\u228 \'e4hnt wird \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Iacobus Schonefelder, \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 338v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Iohannes de Erkingen alias Sidennneger, \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 339r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Iohannes Lang. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Ihnen wird anscheinend die Berechtigung zuerkannt als Notare zu fungieren. \line 339v Formel \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Annunciacio commissarii< N. clericus alias B. decretorum doctor ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... Datum in opido ... anno domini 146VIII (?). \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 340r (330r)\endash 341v Vereidigungstexte; Erw\u228 \'e4hnung weiterer Personen (341v), Datum Rom {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://5060[0].5064/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 1468}}\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , als Zeugen \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Henricus Biberlinck celerarius ecclesie Hallverstetensis, Nicolaus Dehart decanus ecclesie Querfordensis, Iohannes Craversversis (?) clericus Erbipolensis diocesis, \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 testiert \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Iohannes Mollitoris de Pegaw clericus N\u252 \'fcenburgensis diocesis ... notarius. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 342v sp\u228 \'e4ter eingetragen: R\u252 \'fccktritt und letzte Verf\u252 \'fcgung des Iohannes Lang \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Cum dei potencia (?) omnibus mei sanguinis Auguste sum orbatus qui michi cum tempus postulaverat meis negociis laboraverunt ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Erw\u228 \'e4hnt wird \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Iohannes vicarius in Erkingen. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash 339r oben eine Randbemerkung (Monatsnamen). }

Nisus huic fidus comes erat. Harum rerum callidus magister ... etc. Salutare // \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 ed. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Wolkan\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 I 1, 353\endash 393. ed. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Morall\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , 1988. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 352v\endash 353r Musterbriefe (Universit\u228 \'e4t Leipzig) (1) 1465 Sept. 27 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Littere testimoniales \emdash In nomine domini amen. Anno a nativitate eiusdem M CCCC LXV indiccione dridecima (!) die vero vicesima septima mensis Iulii hora vesperorum (!) vel quasi pontificatus sanctissimi ... Pauli ... pape secundi anno eius primo in opido Lipczensi Merseborgensis diocesis commendabilis vir Gerhardus n. de Rom. etc. clericus ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (2) 1466 Januar \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Forma signeti notarialis (?)< Nos Theodricus de Schonnbergk Missnensis (!) ac sancti Petri in Budissin ecclesiarum prepositus ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (3), 1466, Januar 15 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Forma subdelegacionis< Andreas Botcher in iure canonico licentiatus decanus ecclesie Mersborgensis ... conservator privilegiorum ... alme universitatis studii Lipczensis ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... Datum anno etc. LX sexto die vero decima quinta mensis Ianuarii ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 353r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Forma citacionis necnon arestacionis< Iohannes Grundemma (?) arcium magister sacre que theologie licentiatus, prepositus canonicorum regularium monasterii sancte (!) Thome apostoli in Lipczck ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Wiederum genannt \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Andreas Botcher \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... non obstantibus vobis dominis omnibus. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash Rest der Seite leer. \line 353v siehe unten. }

Testat (355r) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Et ego Laurentius natus Mathie de Apol (!) clericus Wratislaviensis diocesis ... notarius publicus ... in hanc publicam formam redegi ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (2) 355r\endash 356r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Forma constitucionis procuratoris potestatis ...< In nomine domini amen. Anno nativitatis eiusdem millesimo quadringentesimo sexagesimo octavo ... die vero septimo mensis Aprilis .... in bursa salis in habitacione Iohannis Lang rectoris in Kesingen opidi Lipczensis Morstburgensis (!) diocesis ... vir J. L. arcium magister clericus Augustensis d iocesis membrum universitatis Lipczensis ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash endet \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... debiteque inquisitis. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Testat \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Et ego Adam Berbam (?) de Aquisgrani clericus Leodiensis diocesis arcium magister publicus ... notarius ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (3) 356r\endash v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >In nomine sancte ... trinitatis ...< In presenti actu per ordinem quatuor incumbunt facienda. Primo habeo divini nominis invocacionem ... premittere, secundo facienda est ... sacre canonice sciencie recommendacio, tercio legere habeo titulum michi per dominos doctores facultatis iuridice assignatum, quarto et ultimo omnibus ... graciarum sunt actiones ... referende ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... Auscultata est presens copia per me Iohannem clericum Augustensis diocesis publicum ... notarium ... }

Dicit Bernardus: Per hec verba dominus nos omnes ad eternitatem vocat ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... benedixitque tibi deus ad introitum in evum. Hec nobis prestare dignetur. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Unten \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >1479. Erfurto (?)< \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Schneyer\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 1,744 (Conradus de Brundelsheim, Expl. variiert) und 6,429. \line (6) 326r\endash 327v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Sancti per fidem vicerunt ..., Ad Hebr. 11 cap. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (33)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Ovidius libro 2\u176 \'b0 sine titulo: Quid inquit decuit regem ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... adepti sunt repromissiones; ad quas nos perducat Ihesus Christus. >1479 collectus per lectorem Piscatoris< \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Gehalten 1479, in Erfurt laut 325r und 317v (\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs20 ex Iordano in collegio\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 : aus einer Iordanus-Handschrift der Kollegs- bzw. Mercenarius autem et ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash Mit deutschen Einsprengseln \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Nit sprich von dir selbs guot Auch schiltich nit wen wer das selb tuot. Iuxta thema tres articulos declarabo; quantum ad primum. Bohecius de consolacione ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... Dicit ergo: Mundus gaudebit. Notandum quod quadruplici racione dicitur spiritus sanctus ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 342v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Amen dico vobis si quid pecieritis patrem ..., Ioh. 16 cap \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (23)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . In hoc ewangelio tria principaliter declarabuntur, primo similitudo ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 361r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Nemo potest venire ad me ..., Ioh. 6 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (44)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . \uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 1r\endash 16r {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://bezwrk[0].6930/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Sermones de textu 'Inmutemur habitu in cinere et cilicio'}}\plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Inmutemur habitu in cinere et cilicio. Cuius nichil est aliud quam lignum per ignem in cinerem conversum; per lignum duricia peccati intelligitur. Secundum quot (!) dicit apostolus \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (I Cor 3,11)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 : Fundamentum aliud nemo potest ponere preter id quod positum est; super hoc fundamentum alii edificant aurum, argentum, lapides preciosos ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash 2v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... ipso auxiliante. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (2) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Quoniam de corrupta radice primi hominis descendimus, idcirco sine peccato in hac corrputibili carne nequaquam nascimur ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash 4r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 regnum quod vobis paratum. ad quod nos. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (3) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Egrogotavit (!) Ezechias usque ad mortem et in introivit ad eum Isayas filius Amos propheta et dixit ... et non vives \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Is 38,1 u.a.)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . Iste Ezechias qui rex erat Christum significat ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash 6r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... sanant peccatorum vulnera. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (4) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Dicit propheta immo dominus per prophetam: Convertimini ad me et ego convertar ad nos, ac si diceret: Propter peccata et iniquitates ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash 7v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... et ad vitam eternam; ad quam nos perducat. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (5) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Dixit Isayas: Si abstuleris de medio tui catenam et desieris digitum extendere et loqui quod non prodest ... Semper per medium autem cor fratres intelligite ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash 8v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... et ab ore iniquam locutionem. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (6) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Inmutemur habitu in cinere et cilicio. Unde hic sequitur et desieris digitum extendere et loqui quod non prodest, deinde debet operari bonum. Bonum autem ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash 10r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... quando in eterna beatitudine illum reficit; ad quam. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (7) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Ductus est Iesus in desertum a spiritu ut temptaretur a diabolo. Tria proponit nobis divina scriptura, videlicet Egiptum. desertum et Ierusalem ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash 11r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... pervenire valeatis, ipso auxiliante qui vivit ... Amen. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (8) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Venit Elyas \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Isayas \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 expungiert)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 in Bersabee Iude et dimisit ibi puerum suum et perrexit per desertum viam unius diei \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (III Reg. 19,3)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . Helias iste aliquem fidelem significat qui debet ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash 12v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... et perduret in eternum in secula seculorum. Amen. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (9) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Assumpsit Iesus Petrum et Iacobum ... sicut nix \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Mc 9,1)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . Isti tres discipuli tres ordines qui sunt in ecclesia dei significant; quorum alii sunt clerici, alii laici, alii monachi ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash 14r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... valeatis, ipso auxiliante; quesumus. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (10) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Sicut in veteri testamento legitur dixit Rebecca filio suo Iacob: Audivi patrem tuum loquentem ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... meritum videlicet et premium. Meritum est in opere, premium in mercede operus. Meritum est in hac vita. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash 1r oben moraltheologische Note (\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... Age penitenciam ...\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ). \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Nr. 3\endash 4, 6\endash 10 auch in N\u252 \'fcrnberg, StB, Cent. V, 82, Nr.1, siehe Karin \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Schneider\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Die Hs. der Stadtbibliothek N\u252 \'fcrnberg, Band II Teil 1, S.308\endash 312, hier 308 (dieser Teil der Hs. 13.Jh.; "Initien dieser von \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Schneyer\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 nicht ber\u252 \'fccksichtigten Sammlung nur im Register"). \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs20 Inmutemur habitu in cinere et cilicio\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 : liturgisch. }

\uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 17vb {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://bezwrk[0].6930/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Prosae de vanis mundi gaudiis}}\plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (1) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 O quam beati a mundo quos cernimus dampnatos quos pura conscienscia perducit ad gaudia sine fine permansura. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (2) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Heu quod potentes, heu quod nobiles in die illa perhibunt, quod divites, quod sapientes lugebunt. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (3) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 O mundi dulcia, o vana gloria, ve illis qui diligunt illa. / \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (4) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 O virgo pia, o celi regina, mater Christi Maria, in qua pendet spes universorum, ne despicias gemitus miserorum, sed veniam cunctis fidelibus posce defunctis, ut fili (!) tui sanguine de lacu mortis educti ad fontem vite sine fine per te gaudeant introducti. / \line Cum celum mutatur ac terra moveatur, tunc veniet sanctus sanctorum in nubibus polorum ascendens ...stria (?) sua. \line O quam felix anima, quam levat iusticia dicens in gaudio viso suo domino Miserere mei miserere mei, tu mea spes sanctorum et requies, sancte suscipe me. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash Mit Noten. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 (2)\endash (3) entsprechen Str. 1 und 2 des Tropus super Libera me Domine (AH 49 S.384 Nr.783). Wie hier steht 'quod' anstelle von 'quot'. \u220 \'dcberliefert nur in einem 'Orationale ms. Schonaugiense saec.12 (Privatbesitz)'; daraus bei \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Roth\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Das Gebetbuch der hl. Elisabeth von Sch\u246 \'f6nau, Augsburg 1886, S.49: "Viel \u196 \'c4hnlichkeit im Aufbau ... zeigt ein Tropus zum \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs20 Libera\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 des Brevieres, welches im Antiphonar ms. Augiense auf fol.262r eingetragen ist und von Mone (Nr.296) publiziert wurde"; textuelle \u220 \'dcbereinstimmungen mit diesem \u220 \'dcberlieferungszeugen siehe unten zu 'Dum recordor' (17vb).}

\uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 17vb {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://bezwrk[0].6930/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Versus ('Dum recordor')}}\plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Dum recordor toto corde / in qua mundus iacet sorde \line totus mundus valde sordet / et cor totum se remordet. \line Dum recordor mundi florem / et quem habet flos odorem \line tantus dolor est in flore / quod flos non sit in odore. \line Dum recordor diem ire / in qua Christe (?) advenit de (?) \line non tardabit ut vindictam / reddat miser quem (?) tunc (?) d.... (?) \line Dum recordor quod sim cinis / et quod cito venit finis \line sine fine pertimesco / nam et cinis refrigesco. \line Dum recordor breves dies / et eosdem esse leves \line grave fit quod fuit leve / et fit longum quod est breve. \line Lacrimosa dies illa / qua (?) resurget de favilla \line iudicandus homo reus (?) / pro peccatis parce (?) deus. \line O quam dura successura / mors exercet sua iura. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Walther\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Initia, 4938 (diese Hs.), 3737. }

HB I Asc. 95', inc. in den Zeugen \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs20 O vae sic dicant miserae\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 ). \u220 \'dcbereinstimmend nur 1\endash 3, 9\endash 10. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 17vb Notizen \emdash Auf unterem Blattrand unter Spalte a \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Contra febres H. Ratio quare, II. Quod de electorum gloria privaberis, si communicare nolueris, III ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... Vita domini, XXVIII. \line >I< Adest dies quam fecit dominus, exultemus. Adest dies deo gloriosa, angelo hominique iocunda, exultemus. Adest dies triumphatae mortis destructione amabilis, triumphantis dei resurrectione celebris, exultemus. Exultemus, inquam, non in veteri fermento ... >II< Vincatur corpus, vincat spiritus, refrenetur temporanea carnis iocunditas ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \line Endet \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... qui motum nesciens universa moveris, qui sine termino, sine principio, qui personis trinus, substantia individuus; ipsi gloria, in seculorum secula. Amen. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 20v ca. 11 Zeilen nach Gebrauch von Lesetinte unleserlich. 22r eine Halbzeile in Rasur. \emdash Kapitelz\u228 \'e4hlung r\u246 \'f6misch am Rand rot}

\uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 23r {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://bezwrk[0].6930/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Oratio sacerdotis missam celebraturi}}\plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Benignissime ac misericordissime, fortissime ac clementissime domine deus omnipotens, cui omnis angelica famulatur virtus, cui quicquid iusticie, quicquid pietatis est, assistit, propitius ante conspectum divine maiestatis tue reus assisto sacrosancti misterii usurpator satis indignus, qui nec invocare sanctum ac venerabile nomen tuum sum ydoneus ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Es folgt ein S\u252 \'fcndenkatalog. \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... omnium scelerum meorum indulta propitiatio. Amen. Per te Ihesu Christe fili dei vivi qui es redemptor mundi. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Wortlaut an einen 'liber sacramentorum' anklingend. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 23v Quod nulli sacerdotum amplius quam semel liceat communicare \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Quod nulli sacerdotum amplius quam semel liceat secundum auctores communicare, sed vix ex racionabili necessitate bis< Christus si semel oblatus sufficiens fuit hostia ad redemptionem generis humani, sufficit uni sacerdoti semel passus semel in die representare immolatum; quod amplius est a malo est puta a cupiditate vel grossa ignorantia ... ... Sed rurenses presbiteri et civitatum temeritate, non ex iusticia presumunt; dico: numquam fiat; sed quod minime expediat. Ideo quidam Salzeburgensis episcopus decimas a manu laicorum retrahens ecclesiis et barrochiis (!) reddidit ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... Christi sacramenta non percipiunt in terra viventium, ideo communicatoribus Christi interesse non potuerunt. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Salzburg? \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 23v Notae de celebratione missae \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Tribus de causis canon sub silentio agitur, quia Christus tribus diebus in sepulchro fuit coopertus, ita et nos corpus et sanguinem cum calice ter cooperimus usque tres articulos orationis compleamus sub silentio ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... ut nullus canonem dicat nisi ad hoc consecrati (!) et in loco statuto. \line Triplici de causa corpus Christi sub alia specie sumitur; prima est ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... crucifixerunt viciis et concupiscentiis. Nota ideo ymago crucifixi in ecclesiis erigitur ... Nota ideo flectamus genua dicimus, quia corpus et animam nos humiliare in penitentiam innuimus ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Syntax!)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... qui in terram prostratus dominum adoravit. }

Foroneus rex Grecis primus leges iuditiaque constituit. Mercurius Trimegestus primus leges Eigiptiis (!) tradidit ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... Theodosianum vocavit. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Zitiert auch in der Lex Baiuvariorum, Prologus, ed. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Schwind\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , MGH Legum Sectio 1, Legum nationum Germanicarum V pars 2. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 28rb Augustinus: Tractatus in evangelium Iohannis VI 25 (excerptum) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Augustinus an (?) siquid (!) Iohannem: Quo iure deffendis villas ecclesie? Divino an humano? Divinum in scriptis habemus, humanum in legibus regum ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... Tolle iura imperatoris, nemo dicit: Hec villa mea et de ceteris}

\uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 40v\endash 49v {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://bezwrk[0].6930/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Quaestiones e schola Rolandi et Metelli (18)}}\plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Ohne Trennung vom Vorangehenden. \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Delictorum quedam sunt manifesta, quedam sunt occulta. Item occultorum quedam legitimis allegationibus comprobantur ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash 41r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... respondere nisi omnia sibi restituantur. \line >De decimis< In sexta decima ca\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 [pitulo de]\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 decimis quoddam continetur decretum, quod duobus modis possumus interpretari ... ... Ruolandus sic determinat illorum privilegia ... \line Prima questio est, utrum filii qui nati sunt ante compaternitatem vel post possint copulari ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 41v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Questio talis proponitur< Quidam cupiens dateoperam \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (!)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 scolasticis disciplinis obtulit pecuniam prelato sui, ut liceret ei habere prebendam suam dum esset in scolis ... ... Solutio: Dicit Rudlandus ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 42r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Causa talis est< Quidam episcopus nepotem habebat ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 43r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Quidam verberibus afflictus ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Quidam sua tradidit canonice regulari et induit se habitu regulari ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 44r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Habuimus in tractatu consecrationis, quod nulli liceat edificare ecclesiam inconsulto Romano pontifice ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 45r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Nobilis quidam quandam sibi desponsavit ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 46r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Sacerdos quidam quandam adamavit et ex ea filios generavit ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 46v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Quidam in coniugio erant copulati, quorum unus sancti spiritus spiraculo tactus ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 47r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Quidam cuidam iuravit, ut duceret in uxorem tali condicione ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 47v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Quedam tradidit filiam suam invitam et reclamantem nuptui tota Vienna sciente ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 48r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Episcopus quidam cuiusdam plebis capellam archipresbitero invito ad alterius plebis diocesim transmutavit ... Cuiusdam consanguinei ut in archiepiscopum eligerent infinitam pro eius electione peccuniam promiserunt ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 48v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Laicus quidam diabolico instinctu ductus quandam monacham sibi in matrimonium sociavit ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... cum propter res publicas prosperas iudex publicam facit abolitionem. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 42v, 43r marginal rot \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Rudlandus< \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash 47v Stadt Wien (?) erw\u228 \'e4hnt. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Teilausgabe: R. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Weigand\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , 1969, 82\endash 94. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Weigand\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , 1980, S.4 Anm. 10: "Die Quaestionen und 1a geh\u246 \'f6ren noch zu den Sentenzen des Rolandus, w\u228 \'e4hrend die Questionen 20 und 21 bereits zum Fragmentum Cantabrigiense geh\u246 \'f6ren." Diese M\u252 \'fcnchener Quaestionen stehen in einem engen Zusammenhang mit den sog. Stuttgarter Quaestionen. Zu Rolandus canonista vgl. auch LMA, VII 962. \emdash Frau Kerstin A. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Jacobi\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Bochum, arbeitet derzeit \u252 \'fcber die kanonistischen Teile der Handschrift (f.24r\endash 51v). }

Mancipium sive servus, si fuerit emancipatus idest a servitute liberatus dicetur (!) libertinus, huius filius dicetur (!) libertus. Liberti autem filius dicetur liber, licet plerumque hec differencia non servetur, unde versus: \line Libertinus erit de servo factus, ac inde libertus \line cuius de sanguine liber habetur. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 58rb \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Municeps est qui in municipio liber natus est. Item qui ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... et nota quod ille genitivus 'carnis' non est ab hoc nominativo 'caro', sed ab illo qui est 'carnis'. Antiqui enim declinabant Hec carnis, huius carnis // \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Abbruch)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Siehe August E. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Anspach\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Las Etimolog\u237 \'edas en la tradici\u243 \'f3n manuscrita medieval, Leon 1966, S.170.}

Quadrupliciter mundus debet a nobis contempni quia varius, calcari quia sordidus ... Anima pro diversis actibus diversa sortitur vocabula ... (anima, animus, conscientia, mens, memoria ...) \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 61r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Sitivit anima mea ad deum fontem ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Ps. 41,3)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Fons ille Christus filius dei, qui primo tantum potavit angelos ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >De passione Christi< Quatuor sunt flumina paradysi, primus dicitur Geon, secundus Tigris, tercius Physon ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Angelus domini non percutiebat signatos. \uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 60v {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://bezwrk[0].6930/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Versus ('Confessor dulcis')}}\plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (1) {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://5650[1].5666l/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Confessor dulcis affabilis atque fuavis}}\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 (!) \line Prudens discretus ma(...)iti pius esto benignus. \line Sit simplex humilis confessio pura fidelis. \line Vera frequens (!) nuda discreta libens verecunda \line Integra secreta lacrimabilis accelerata. \line Fortis et accusans et sit parere parata, \line Se non excuset confessio, singula narret. \line Quis, quid, ubi, quibus auxiliis, cur quoque (?) quando \line Aggravat ordo, locus, modus atque sciencia, tempus. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (2) \u167 \'a7 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Ortus (?), baptismus, mors, tumba, resurrectio vite, \line Scansio, iudicium tibi dant signacula septem. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (3) \u167 \'a7 {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://5650[0].5666l/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Mors (!) mala, mors intus; malus actus, mors foris; usus}}\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 \line Tumba: puella, puer: Lazarus ista notant. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \line Die ersten 3 Verse mit Interlinearglossen ('in increpando, audiendo, consolando'). \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 (1) Unter den Gedichten des Petrus Blesensis in der PL 207, 1153: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs20 Confessor mitis, affabilis atque benignus / Sit sapiens ...\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Teil des 'Peniteas cito', der Summa penitentiae, die dem Iohannes de Garlandia zugeschrieben wird. Die Verse hier in stark abweichender Form und Reihenfolge. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Walther\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Initia 3135. \emdash Zu (2): \u196 \'c4hnliche Verse zitiert Thomas de Chobham, Summa de arte praedicandi, 15,10: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs20 Sunt autem septem signacula eius que notantur hiis uersibus: natio, baptismus, mors, tumba, resumptio uite, scansio, iudicium tibi sint signacula septem.\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 \emdash Zu (3) PL 171, 1279. A.B. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Scott\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 / D.F. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Baker\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 u.a., The Biblical Epigrams of Hildebert of Le Mans : a critical edition, in: MS 47 (1985) 310. Nur ein Distichon im Florilegium von St. Gatien, siehe A. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Wilmart\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Rev.B\u233 \'e9n. 48 (1936) 27, Flor. 125. \u220 \'dcberlieferung anscheinend auf Frankreich konzentriert. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Walther\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Initia 10911. }
Mens mala, mors intus; malus actus, mors foris; usus

Infelices enim filii Adam ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 67r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 In adventu domini quem hodie celebramus, si personam venientis intueor ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 71r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Magna opera domini ait propheta. Magna quibem (!) omnia opera eius, fratres, siquidem et ipse magnus est ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 72v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Duo quedam rerum genera, fratres mi, in hac nativitate domini considero \u8230 \'85 \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 74v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Cognoscite fratres dilectissimi, quanta sit hodierna sollempnitas, cui et dies brevis et terre angusta latitudo ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 75r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Postquam consummati sunt dies octo ut circumcideretur puer ... Audivimus paucis expressum magnum pietatis sacramentum ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 76v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 In circumcisione domini fratres habemus quod habemus (!) et admiremur ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 79r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Triplicem huius festivitatis racionem a sanctis patribus traditam esse ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 82r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Tres apparitiones domini legimus una quidem die, sed non uno tempore factas ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 83v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Populo dure cervicis cultellus erat necessarius ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 84v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Convertimini ad me in toto corde vestro ... Walther). \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 84v Versus \line (1) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Quamvis divise tres partes sint ibi vise \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 / \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Non est facte rei divisio sed specierum. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Nicht verifiziert.) \line (2) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Utile lex humile res ignorari (?) necesse. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Zwei Verse in Danzig, F 227, f.42, vgl. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 G\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 \u252 \'fc\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 nther\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , IV). \line (3) Zusatz (13./14.Jh.): \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Loth decus hospicii, paciencia Iop, Salomonem \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 / \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Dogma, fides Abraham, spes Simeona beat. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Matthaeus Vindocinensis, Thobias, Praefatio v.3\endash 4). \emdash Marginal Etymologie von \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 misericordia. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 85r\endash v {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://bezwrk[2].6930/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Textus theologici de nativitate Christi}}\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 fragmentum \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... Secundum illum psalmigraphum: Pauper sum et ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... quam preparavit deus diligentibus se. Ame}

\uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 110r\endash 125v {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://bezwrk[0].6930/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Sermones de tempore}}\plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (1) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >De sancto Andrea sermo primus< Ambulans Ihesus etc. Istud evangelium dividitur in tres partes. Prima pars notatur ibi: Ambulans Ihesus scilicet querendo perditos. Secunda pars notatur ibi: Vocavit Petrum et Andream, et hic notatur quod vocavit aversos ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (2) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Item de sancto Andrea apostolo sermo secundus< Dilexit Andream dominus in odore suavitatis. Erat in veteri testamento odor suavis ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (3) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Item sermo tercius< Venite post me etc. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Mc 1,17)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Nota qualis debeat esse quem dominus vocat ad hec sublimia, videlicet ad vitam apostolicam, ad sequendum se, ad homines capiendos ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (4) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >De sancto Nycolao episcopo sermo primus< Quasi vas auri solidum etc. Ecclesiasticus \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (50,19)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . Beatus Nicolaus fuit vas, in quo dominus omnes liquores bonos medicinales posuit ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 110v (5) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Item de sancto Nicolao< Manus eius tornatiles, Cant. (5,14). Tornatiles idest polite et volubiles sive faciles ad operandum, ita fuit beatus Nicolaus ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (6) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >De sancta Lucia< Quis nos separabit a caritate Christi, Ad Cor. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (8,35). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Caritas beate Lucie erga Christum patuit in quinque, primo in dei fiducia ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash Endet mit \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Dominica XI< Resedit qui erat mortuus, Lu. VII\u176 \'b0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (15)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . Secundum quadruplicem mortem quatuor sunt genera mortuorum. Quidam enim sunt mortui ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... eis semel mori ne in eternum moriantur, quomodo dicunt montibus cadice (!) super nos et coll. oper. ni // \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Abbruch\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Schneyer\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Wegweiser, S.22: Predigt (1) nur diese Hs.; \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Schneyer\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Beobachtungen, S.30. \emdash (2) London, BL, Royal 10 C.v, f.395. G\u252 \'fcssing, [1]/43, f.243r. Letzte Predigt auch in Klosterneuburg, 451, f.144\endash 145 Nr.1}

\uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 53va\endash 57vb {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://bezwrk[0].6930/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Sermones}}\plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Motto \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Sancti spiritus assit nobis gracia. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash (1) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Sermo de assumpcione< Maria abiit in montana \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Lc 1,39)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . Omnes scimus quod locus ille inferior non est locus stellarum ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash 55va \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... choros angelorum ad celestia regna, ad que nos etc. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (2) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Maria abiit in montana \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Lc 1,39)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . Dictum est quare Maria vocatur singulariter stella maris, nunc dicatur, quare illa loca superiora vocantur montana ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash 57rb \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... eam sequi ad illa montana idest ad gaudia sempiterna, ad que nos perducat etc. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (3) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Benedicta es tu filia a domino \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Iudith 13, 23)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . Ieronimus dicit in quodam sermone de beata virgine: Timeo cum eam laudare volo ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash 57vb \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... meminerit defuisse. Ideo recurremus ad illam. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (4) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Benedicta es tu filia a domino \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Iudith 13, 23)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . Sicut de re parva non fit umbra magna, sic de modico verbo non auditur magna figura in scriptura ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... responsio ad hanc interrogationem // \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Abbruch, Reklamant:\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 dicitur ibi. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 (3) Als 'Commentaire sur Benedicta es tu filia a Domino' in Paris, Arsenal, 530 (581 T T L) 2\u176 \'b0, f.133v (CGMBP Arsenal 1 p. 386)}

\uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 196r\endash v {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://bezwrk[0].6930/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Versus memoriales}}\plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (1) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Tres tribus Anna viris fertur genuisse Marias / Ex Ioachim Cleopha, Saloma tres Anna Marias / Quas peperit iunxit Ioseph, Alpheo, Zebedeo / Unius hec mater, hec quatuor, illa duorum. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (2) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Credere sincere quadrans est primus in ere \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (oder \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 pro muliere\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ?)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 / Alter sincere quadrans est ore tenere / Tercius implere, quartus completa docere. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (3) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Cur homo qui cinis es, per avariciam sepelis es / Eri cur heres, eris qui non eris heres. / Cumque sepultus eris, quicumque sepultor est (?) eris / Non hodie quod [h]eri novus heres imperat eri. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (4) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Nec laus nec probitas nec honor dare se meretrici / Est vicium th(?) veneris (?) vincere, laudis honor. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (5) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Cum sis iam fortis, non des tua munera stortis / Scribitur in portis: Meretrix est ianua mortis. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 196rb (6) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Quisquis eris qui transieris, sta perlege, plora / Sum quod eris fueramusque quod es, pro me precor ora. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (7) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Miles eram martis, Mars multos vicit acer in me (??) Nunc cedit mora (?) Mars et mors militat in me. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (8) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Bernardus: Difficile est non habita non cupere, difficilior oblata respuere, difficillimum possessa relinquere. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash Anschlie\u223 \'dfend ein Prosa-Schema \u252 \'fcber Enthaltsamkeit. \line 196v Nachtr\u228 \'e4ge: \line (a) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Mors tua, mors Christi, lux ultima, gaudia celi / et dolor inferni sint memoranda tibi. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (b) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Egrediar sed nescio quo, sed nescio quando / Sed fortasse dies iste suppremus erit. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (c) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Iterum a.bis .. mala sunt capitalia ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (d) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Pene: Visio virtus edax nox fetor fe.. et ignis / Peccati confusio despectio (?) flag(or) / Iterum petit (?) tibi non videantur (?) amene. / \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Daneben eine mathematische Note. \line (e) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Christi...:< A bis (?) et s. sicud o bis fi semel M. C. que duplex / Tot mandata dei grammata dena notant. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (f) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Non hanc, non assumas non sabatus solvas / Detur honor nisi occidas, caveas fore mechus / Fur, falsus testis, aliene coniugis ardor / Atque rei natu (?) sunt hec inimica deo. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash Rest der Seite leer. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 (1) In verschiedenen anderen Handschriften, vgl. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Walther\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Initia 19420; 'In principio'. \emdash (2) Vgl. Dublin, Trinity College, 331 (C.4.22), f.46r (siehe M.L. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Colker\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Descriptive Catalogue of the Mediaeval and Renaissance Latin Manuscripts, I\endash II, 1991). \emdash (3) Versus de homine: Auch im Hortus deliciarum der Herrad von Landsberg, siehe dazu \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Werner\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Beitr\u228 \'e4ge, S.196. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Werner\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Sprichw\u246 \'f6rter, S.16 Nr.204. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Walther\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Initia 3925. \emdash (4) Vers 1 \u228 \'e4hnlich in Simons de Aurea Capra Versus de exidio Troiae, Fassung 2, I 75 ('In principio'). Vgl. auch \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Walther\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Initia 11687. \emdash (5) \u196 \'c4hnlich bei \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Werner\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Lateinische Sprichw\u246 \'f6rter des MA, Nr.192 S.16. \emdash (6) \u196 \'c4hnlich \u246 \'f6fter in Epitaphien. \emdash (a) \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Walther\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Initia 11275. Mit der Lesart 'fraus mundi, gloria celi' des Verses 1 mehrfach bekannt (vgl. 'In principio'). \emdash (b) Hildeberti Cenomanensis De conflictu carnis et animae, PL 171, c.992B. }

\uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 219va\endash 220rb {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://bezwrk[0].6930/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 De homonymis (partim metrice}}\plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 ) \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Dic quid sit jrundo, quid sit irudo, qualis arundo. Ales jrundo ... Duius (?) semideus dis deus atque theos ... Ors (?) et terra solum tellus humus arida sicca Proles prosapia stirps progeniesque genusque ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... Hoc capud, hoc corpus nosque membra sumus. Consequenter abusiva XII huius seculi, de quibus Augustinus loquitur: Sapientia sine operibus, senex sine religione, adolescens sine obedientia, dives sine elemosina, femina sine pudore, dominus sine virtute, Christianus contentiosus, pauper superbus, rex iniqus (!), episcopus negligens, plebs sine disciplina, populus sine lege. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Vgl. 'Dic quid hyrundo quid sit hirudo' in Oxford, Bodl. Libr., Digby 53, f.5v\endash 8. Vgl. dazu T. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Hunt\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Teaching and learning latin in thirteenth-century England, Cambridge 1991. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 220ra\endash rb Sententiae de scriptura sacra \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 De Salomone et Iram dicato a Salomone usque Galileam \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (vgl. III Reg. 9)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 et Tirium et de enigmatibus eorum et de Abdemone Abdemonis filio, per quem faciliter omnia explicabat. Item de operibus et mirabilibus Salomonis et ad horum incredibilem opinionem regina Sabba excitata venit temptare eum in enigmatibus ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (vgl. III Reg. 10)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... propter metum Iezabel. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Wohl nach der 'Historia scholastica'. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 220rb De electuario (?) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Si quis possidet electuarium materiale preciosum et efficax, hic (?) multa morborum genera haberet ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (9 Zeilen)}

\uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 220rb {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://bezwrk[0].6930/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Proverbia}}\plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (1) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Carne sub hac (?) fragili quid amas homo gaudia mundi \line Cuius (?) tua cara caro vile cadaver erit. \line Etas divicie probitas sapiencia forma \line Nobilitas mortis lege coacta ruunt. \line Cesar cui erat tocius gloria mundi \line In vili tumulo morte iubente iacet. \line Magnus Alexander Tideus Paris Ector (?) Achilles \line Contraxere titeram(?) de probitate(?) necem. (Contingere citeram??) \line Absalone (?) Salomon sapiens hic ille decori \line Infeste mortis colla dedere iugo. \line Talibus et tantis sana probitate probatis \line Parcere que nescit, parceret illa tibi. \line Parcet egestati non parcens nobilitati \line Non parcens iuveni procerum illa sevi (?) \line Decet ut structo parcat sapiente sepulto \line Deformis manet \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 uanat\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 cod.)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 , forma decens pereat \line Tu quid es, quid heres, quid agis, quid amas, quid adunas \line Tolte (?) festinat flebilis hora tibi. // \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (2) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Unde superbit homo cuius concepcio culpa, / nasci pena dolor vita necesse mori. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (3) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Post hominem vermis, post vermem \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 fit cito pulvis \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 expungiert)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 , fit cinis heu heu. \line Sic in non hominem vertitur omnis homo. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (PL 184, c.490)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (4) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Cum fex, cum limus, cum res vilissima simus \line Unde superbimus, ad terram terra redimus. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 (2) PL 184, c.538. Deinceps ewangelium et epistolas canonicas tres et Apocalypsin scripsit. Drusianam viduam, que eum secuta fuerat, a defunctis relevavit; gemmas a duobus fratribus confractas redintegravit ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 220vb \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Est velle rationis et velle sensualitatis. Velle rationis vel est ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 221r\endash v Petrus Manducator: Sermo \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Sancti spiritus assit nobis gratia. \emdash Ex Egipto vocavi filium meum \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Os 11,1)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . Tria esse loca ex sacre scripture eruditione ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash Endet \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... in tercia deus suscitatur. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Folgen einige Exzerpte: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Sine intermissione orate \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (I Thes. 5,17)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 aut totum tempus posuit pro parte apostolus ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 usw. \line 221v Bernhardus Claraevallensis, Sententiae (PL 183, c.749D): \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Tria sunt oscula: reconciliatorium, remuneratorium, contemplatorium. Primum ad pedes, secundum ad manus, tercium ad os sumitur. \uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 174r\endash 227v {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://bezwrk[0].6930/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Exzerptsammlung zu verschiedenen theologischen, moralphilosophischen und naturkundlichen Themen}}\plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Vermutlich aus Schriften des Iohannes Klenkok, besonders aus dessen Commentarius super actus apostolorum (namentlich zitiert ab f.206r). \emdash 174r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Utrum cicatrices wlnerum et discontinuacio fuerit in Christo post resurreccionem, cum Christus dicit Thome: Mitte manum in latus meum, Ioh. ultimo \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (20,27)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . Dicendum quod cicatrices fuisse et esse in Christo omnes doctores quasi concedunt, sed de wlneribus idest de discontinuacione plane negat Albertus ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... si nulla wlnera precessissent. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Exzerpt desselben Themas in Paris, BN, lat. 14593, f.187. Mehrere Texte zum Thema 'quare Christus servat cicatrices vulnerum' im GI. \emdash Dieser Abschnitt im Inhaltsverzeichnis vorne aufgef\u252 \'fchrt. \line 174r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Narrat Aristoteles XIII\u176 \'b0 libro de animalibus quod infirmitas renum in homine est difficilis curacionis. Moraliter quia in renibus dominatur voluptas, igitur infirmitas renum est carnalis concupiscencia ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 175v\endash 176r Verse \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Dic homo vas cinerum quid, confert flos facierum Copia quid rerum, mors ultima, meta dierum ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... Et in nichilum redit quod ante nichil fuit. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Verse auch in Br\u252 \'fcnn, SOA, G 12 Cerroni II 234, f.9r, und Augsburg, StuSB, 8\u176 \'b0 cod. 15, f.29r. Zu Vers 1\endash 2 vgl. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Walther\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , Proverbia 5561. \line Zahlreiche Zitate auch aus antiker Literatur (Aristoteles mit Commentator, Boethius, Ovidius), auch sowie Exempla, z.B. 177v\endash 178r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Cum ffrater Iordanus in quadam abbacia Cisterciensium receptus fuisset, convenerunt contra eum monachi et secum amicabiliter conferentes quesiverunt ab eo: Magister, quomodo potest ordo vester durare, cum nichil habeatis, unde vivatis? X\u176 \'b0 (31), viam}}\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 , {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://5650[7].5666l/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 per quam omnes homines descendunt}}\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... collocando, qui cum patre et spiritu sancto etc. Amen. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 327v\endash 329v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Levita cum esset secus viam pertransiit, Luc., X\u176 \'b0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (32)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://5650[8].5666l/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Volens predicare ac dei verbum proponere in exequiis alicuius magni dycani (!) utpote cardinalis vel archidyaconi in aliqua ecclesia cathedrali}}\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 premissis breviter hiis que dicta sunt in sermone immediate precedenti de illa viam (!) dura et arta ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... Christus qui transiens ministrabit electis hominibus gloriam sempiternam. Amen. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 329v\endash 333r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Cum adhuc o\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 [r]\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 direr (!) succidit me, Ys. 39\u176 \'b0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Is 38,12)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://5650[9].5666l/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Sicut dicit Basilius super isto verbo, vita hominis congrue comparatur tele, quoniam sicut tela proficit ad}}\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... quamvis forsan ad tempus involvit ea ad temporalem penam; quod sibi et nobis concedat qui sine fine vivit et regnat i.s.s. Amen. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \u196 \'c4hnlich Cgm 660, f.128rb\endash va (K. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Schneider\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ) und Clm 3334 (1477\endash 79, Attel), f.134r-138r ('Sermones pro mortuis'). \line 333r\endash 335v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 In memoria eterna erit iustus, ab audicione mala non timebunt, in Psalmo \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (111,7)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://5650[10].5666l/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 De isto bono viro in iusticia defuncto ac rebus humanis exempto}}\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... et in omnibus stare; quod sibi et nobis concedat qui sine fine vivit et regnat. Amen. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 335v\endash 338v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Memor esto iudicii mei, sic enim erit et tuum, Eccli. XXXVIII\u176 \'b0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Sir 38,23)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://5650[11].5666l/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Verbum est cuiuslibet defuncti hominis vel defuncte mulieris ad quemlibet hominem in vita superstitem, precipue ad quemlibet carum suum, verbum dico}}\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... Sancta et salubris est cogitacio pro defunctis exorare, ut a peccatis solvantur et sic soluti transeant ad vitam eternam, ad quam nos perducat etc. Amen. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 338v\endash 340v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Quo abiit dilectus tuus a (!) pulcherrima mulierum, Cant. V \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Ct 5,17)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://5650[12].5666l/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Tres mulieres sunt quarum quilibet (!) dicitur pulcherrima}}\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... Prima istarum mulierum fuit virgo mater Christi ..., Secunda ... militans ecclesia ..., Tercia quilibet (!) religiosa sacra ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... in sermone XLV Hom\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 [o]\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 quidam nobilis etc. Dicas omnia vel aliqua de illis sicut videbitur tibi et requiret persona de qua predicabis. Amen.}
Sermones XII applicandi in exequiis mortuorum
Prosper de vita contemplativa sic ait: Futura vita creditur beate sempiterna et sempiterne beata, ubi est certa securitas, secura tranquillitas, tranquilla iocunditas
Mos omnium hominum tam bonorum quam malorum indifferenter dicitur obitus. Dicitur enim Gen. 55 de Abraham
Apostolus dicit Hebre. VII (23), quod plures fiebant sacerdotes secundum legem
Universaliter omnes homines moriuntur tam docti quam indocti, tam sapientes quam stulti, Eccles. II° (16): Moritur doctus similiter et indoctus
Propter quatuor homo vel mulier dicitur quasi flos sive florens. Interdum enim dicitur homo vel mulier propter iuvenilem etatem, que
Totum tempus hominis in tres partes dividi potest, videlicet in mane, meridiem et versperam, ut mane sit tempus iuventutis
Accidit ut quidam sacerdos eandem viam descenderet, Luc. X° (31), viam
Viam, per quam omnes homines descendunt
Volens predicare ac dei verbum proponere in exequiis alicuius magni dycani (!) utpote cardinalis vel archidyaconi in aliqua ecclesia cathedrali
Sicut dicit Basilius super isto verbo, vita hominis congrue comparatur tele, quoniam sicut tela proficit ad
De isto bono viro in iusticia defuncto ac rebus humanis exempto
Verbum est cuiuslibet defuncti hominis vel defuncte mulieris ad quemlibet hominem in vita superstitem, precipue ad quemlibet carum suum, verbum dico
Tres mulieres sunt quarum quilibet (!) dicitur pulcherrima

Vgl. Th. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Hohmann\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Initienregister der Werke Heinrichs von Langenstein, in: Traditio 32 (1976) 399\endash 426, hier 407 Nr.74. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Kristeller\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Iter Italicum 3 p. 722 zu T\u252 \'fcbingen, UB, Mc. 144, f.133v. }

\uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 56r\endash 61r {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://bezwrk[0].6930/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Notabilia und Muster f\u252 \'fcr Visitatoren}}\plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 56r\endash v Exemplum de religioso malo (Beda, Historia Anglorum gentis, li. VI? 9) {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://5650[0].5666l/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Utrum (?) religiosus malus gravius damnetur et punietur quam alius}}\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . De hoc inquid Beda in gestis Anglorum libro ultimo capitulo IX\u176 \'b0: Novi ipse fratrem positum in monasterio nobilem, sed ignobiliter viventem. Corripiebatur siquidem sedulo a fratribus ac maioribus loci ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... Factum est hoc, ut inquit Beda quo supra, nuper in provincia Bernitiorum et longe lateque diffamatum multos ad agendam et non differendam scelerum suorum penitudinem provocavit. Hec Beda. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash 56r marginal \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Exemplum. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 56v\endash 57r Muster einer Gratiarum actio \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Sequencia possunt assumi pro graciarum accione in visitacione referenda< Quam graciarum accionem possumus retribuere deo, 1a ad Tess. 3\u176 \'b0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (9)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . Confisus in eius auditorio (!) qui licet magnus magna tamen operatur in minimis quique fragilia humanorum corporum vascula ad sufferenda etiam magna quandoque roborat ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... Sed rogamus reverendi patres et optimi domini ... accipite quesumus ... impares graciarum acciones. etc. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash Mit Zitaten mittelalterlicher (Petrus Damiani) und antiker Autoren (Cicero, Seneca, Maximianus). \line 57r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Ad submittendum se visitacioni monasteriorum assumi potest ex sequentibus aliquale iuvamen< Reverendi etc. Quia in presenti de officio visitacionis deo propicio pauca disserere proposui ac de eius commendacione et ortu ... pro cuius continuacione assumo pro themate verba ista 'Hic est discipulus ille' Ioh. ultimo capitulo ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 59r\endash v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Ad summittendum se visitacioni notabile< Cum iuxta sentenciam apostoli Rom. 14 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Rom 13,9)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 : Omnis anima potestatibus sublimioribus subdita esse debeat, omnis enim potestas ... ... credimus succedere etc. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 60r\endash v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Ad prelatos Humbertus in epistola ad religiosos< Ad vos spectat o prelati speculum subditorum esse, dominium non amare, numquam imperare ... >Ad eosdem idem< Ad vos inquam spectat o prelati esse in accione providos ... >Ad subditos idem< Ut perfectius fratres possitis finem attingere quem intenditis ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... ut possimus dolere de peccatis. etc. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 60v\endash 61r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Sequentia minuunt bonum obedientie< Sunt enim quidam, etsi obediant in quibusdam, tamen in aliis sunt nimis inobedientes. Alii sunt qui ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... elige quod vis. etc. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 56v\endash 57r Zum Initium vgl. MGH Epist. merov., 3, 1899, 296. \emdash 60r\endash v Humbertus de Romanis, Epistola de tribus votis substantialibus religiosorum, unter den Opera ed. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Berthier\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , I 1\endash 41 (\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Kaeppeli\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , SOP, Nr. 2021)}
Utrum religiosus malus gravius damnetur et punietur quam alius.

\uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 61r\endash 71v {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://bezper[0].4100/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Conradus frater sive Conradinus OFM}}\plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 : {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://bezwrk[0].6930/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Sermones VI}}\plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 61r\endash 63v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Sermo bonus ad religiosos fratris Conradi< \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 hinzugef\u252 \'fcgt: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >de quadruplici ordine< \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash 61v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Omnia honeste et secundum ordinem fiant in vobis, 1a Cor. 14 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (40)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . Ad hoc deus karissimi vos vocavit, ut secundum ordinem vivatis, secundum ordinem omnia faciatis. Est autem quadruplex ordo ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... et in quolibet ordine tres lapides. Omnia ergo ho. etc. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 63v\endash 65r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Sermo ad claustrales eiusdem de dilectione< Karissimi, diligamus nos invicem, quia caritas ex deo est, 1a Ioh. 4to \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (7)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://5650[0].5666l/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Etsi omnes homines se invicem diligere debeant, nos tamen claustrales et religiosi maxime diligamus invicem}}\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... aut concupiscentia oculorum aut superbia vite etc. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 65r\endash 66v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Sermo ad clerum eiusdem< Merito hec patimur, quia peccavimus in fratrem nostrum, Gen. 42 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (21)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . Quanta mala clerum nunc involvant, quanta mala ecclesiam istam premant, manifestum est ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... qui in fratrem suum Ihesum Christum peccaverunt. Merito ergo etc. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 66v\endash 68r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Sermo de sacerdotibus et prelatis sive rectoribus eiusdem< Tollant sacerdotes VII iubileorum buccinas et precedant archam, Iosue 6 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (6)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://5650[1].5666l/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Archa est ecclesia quam sacerdotes et rectores precedere debent}}\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... columna enim domus roboratur. etc. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 68r\endash 69v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Sermo bonus ad prelatos eiusdem< Qui maior est vestrum, erit vester minister, Mt. 23 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (11)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://5650[2].5666l/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Salvator his verbis nobis commendat eandem perfectionem ad quam spiritus sanctus hortatur}}\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... et huiusmodi adiuvare. etc. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 69v\endash 71v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Sermo bonus ad prelatos et subditos eiusdem< Qui bene presunt presbiteri, duplici honore digni habentur, Thi. 6 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (I Tim. 5,17)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://5650[3].5666l/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 In verbis apostoli propositis commendatur rectorum circa subditos diligentia}}\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... Nobis ergo bene preesse concedat qui cum patre in unitate spiritus sancti vivit et regnat per omnia s.s. Amen. Expliciunt sex sermones fratris Conradi, qui alias dicuntur sermones Conradini. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 61r\endash 63v: Auch in Bad Windsheim, StB, 58, f.5. \emdash 66v\endash 68r: Auch in Bad Windsheim, StB, 32, f.2. \emdash In Lilienfeld, Stiftsbibl., 50, finden sich 'Sermones 222 in dominicas et festa per annum' des Conradinus O.F.M.}
