\uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 186v\endash 236r {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://bezper[0].4100/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Iodocus Weiler de Heilbrunna}}\plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 : {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://bezwrk[0].6930/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Collationes habitae Wiennae apud Scotos annis 1441\endash 1447}}\plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 186v\endash 192r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Collacio de cena domini magistri Iodoci de Haylbrunna doctoris theologie< Ewangelium quod iam lectum scilicet ante diem festum pasce sicut et totus sermo domini qui habetur in Iohannis ewangelio continet valde salutares doctrinas ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 187r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Exemplum dedi vobis ... et vos faciatis, Ioh. XIII\u176 \'b0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (15)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . Venerabiles patres ... {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://5650[0].5666l/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Quomodo magister et dominus noster Ihesus Christus egit pro nostra salute}}\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... propinquior ac similior erit. Ad quam patriam claritatis et glorie nos via virtutum suarum et exemplis sanctissimis perducere et dirigere dignetur magister et dominus noster Ihesus Christus ... Amen. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 In die cene 1441 beate virginis alias Schotorum. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 192r\endash 198v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Collacio de dilectione proximi< Sermo dominicus qui in parte lectus est in mandato iam habito continet quam plures salubres et efficaces doctrinas et exempla Christi ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 193r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Mandatum novum do vobis, ut diligatis invicem sicut dilexi vos. Venerabiles patres, domini ac fratres ... adamandi. {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://5650[1].5666l/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Beatissimus Augustinus in libro de substancia dileccionis seu diligendorum}}\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... ubi saciatur ... desiderium nostrum; ad quam (!) finem et ad eius perpetuam dileccionem, fidem et spem nostram erigat dominus noster Ihesus Christus in secula benedictus. Amen. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Pronunciatus anno domini M\u176 \'b0 CCCC\u176 \'b0 XLII ipsa die Cene in monasterio beate virginis Wienne alias Schotorum Scotorum (!). \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 198v\endash 207r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Tercius sermo in cena domini< \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 de dilectione dei\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 hinzugef\u252 \'fcgt) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Ewangelium quod iam lectum est scilicet ante diem festum pasce habetur in sermone scilicet Ioh. 13. {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://5650[2].5666l/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 In quo sermone Christus dominus animos discipulorum confortat}}\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... in omni benedictione spirituali in celestibus, ad Ephes. primo \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Eph 1,3)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . Cui cum patre ... sit benediccio ... in secula seculorum. Amen. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 207r\endash 217v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Quartus sermo eiusdem doctoris< Anno 1445 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 gestrichen, hinzugef\u252 \'fcgt: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 In cena domini de pace ac paciencia. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://5650[3].5666l/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Hec locutus sum vobis, ut in me pacem habeatis, in mundo pressuram habebitis, sed confidite, quia ego vici mundum, Ioh. XVI et habentur in sermone domini post cenam facto. Reverendi ... patres ... Salvator noster hodie manducato tipico pascali agno}}\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... qui pro nostra salute suo proprio sangwine nos mercatus est dominus noster Ihesus Christus ... benedictus. Amen. >Anno domini 1445 pronuncciatus in monasterio beate virginis alias Scotorum Wienne in cena domini per venerabilem doctorem magistrum Iodocum< \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 217v\endash 228r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Incipit alius sermo magistri Iodoci reverendi doctoris< \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 218r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Quintus sermo in Cena domini< \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 hinzugef\u252 \'fcgt: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 de humilitate et obediencia. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Discite a me quia mitis sum et humilis corde, Mt. XI. {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://5650[4].5666l/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Hodie cene dominice festum agit sancta ecclesia pro digna memoria}}\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... ... invenietis requiem animabus vestris. 'In principio'). \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 22r\endash 23r Sermo de paenitentia (cum exemplis) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Penitemini et convertemini etc. Act. 3\u176 \'b0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (19)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://5650[23].5666l/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Legitur in vita philosophorum, quod Plato sepe intuebatur faciem eius in speculo }}\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 non propter curiositatem, sed quia vigilaverat et studuerat et volebat scire si esset multus actenuatus et sic poneret modum in studendo et in aliquo se recrearet. Modo speculum quod nos representat est corpus mortuum vicinum quod nobis representat quales futuri sumus, Sap. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Leerraum; Eccli. 38,23) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Memor esto \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Leerraum) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 etc. et si volumus scire utrum debemus ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Zitiert werden Exempla und Auctoritates aus Avicenna, Ambrosius, Hieronymus, Gregorius' Regula pastoralis u.a., \u252 \'fcber einen Wucherer, der keine Reue zeigt (22v), schlie\u223 \'dft (23r) mit der Geschichte einer den Elternmord bereuenden, vom Vater mi\u223 \'dfbrauchten Tochter \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Legitur quod quidam miles habens filiam pulcherrimam cum ea peccavit ... \emdash ... ad patriam evolaverat sine omni purgatorii pena. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash Im Inhaltsverzeichnis f.231v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Feria quarta in ebdomada Pasce 22. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 23r\endash v Sermo de annuntiatione beatae Mariae \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Ave gracia plena dominus tecum, Luc. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (1,28)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://5650[24].5666l/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Volens pater misericordiarum et deus tocius consolacionis humano generi suam misericordiam ostendere misit Gabrielem archangelum de celo ad beatam virginem}}\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... et suscipe filium da fidem et senti virtutem. Ecce autem etc. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash Im Inhaltsverzeichnis f.232r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 De annunciacione beate Marie 23. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 23v\endash 24v Sermo de sancto Laurentio \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Probasti domine cor, cor meum in me examinasti et non est inventa in me etc., Ps.16 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (3)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://5650[25].5666l/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 }}{\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://5650[25].5666l/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Licet ista verba dixerit sanctus propheta David, tamen ecclesia}}\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 exponit ea de beato Laurencio. Glosa: Aliena peccata sunt novem pro quibus aliquis dampnari potest sicut pro propriis. Unde versus: Iussio consilium consensus palpo recursus Participans mutus, non obstans, non manifestans \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (vgl. zu den h\u228 \'e4ufig gebrauchten Versen 'In principio'). \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Isti idem versus in forma habentur in summa Iohannis de restitucionibus libro 2\u176 \'b0 titulo 5\u176 \'b0 questione LXIIIa. Declaracio horum versuum seu peccatorum: Primum est iussio, cum quis iubet alterum peccare ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... idest domino non indicat. Exempla de furtis Qui cum fure etc. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash Im Inhaltsverzeichnis f.231v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 De novem peccatis alienis. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 25v\endash 26v Sermo \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Ascendens Ihesus in naviculam transfretavit et venit in civitatem suam, Math. 9\u176 \'b0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (1)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . Verbum istud exponitur de Maria virgine que hodie per glorie sublimitatem supergressa est omnes creturas (!) ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... ut post hanc vitam eius gloriam quam ipsa possidet in celis mereamur eternaliter videre, quod nobis concedat ... Amen. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Im Inhaltsverzeichnis f.232r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 De assumpcione beate Marie 144. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash Auch in K\u246 \'f6ln, StA, GB fol. 119, f.198r; W\u252 \'fcrzburg, UB, M.ch.f. 188, f.457r u.a. \line 148v\endash 149v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Ave gracia plena dominus tecum, Luc. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (1,28)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . In hoc ewangelio continet (!) exordium nostre salutis in quo quatuor notare possumus; primo a quo sit legacio ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... hoc eciam asscribit Ieronimus et sic patet quod angelus ad formosam virginem missus est que est plena gracia; quam graciam nobis concedere dignetur qui est etc. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Im Inhaltsverzeichnis f.232r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 De annunciacione beate Marie 147. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash Vgl. auch Uppsala, UB, C 75, f.84; auch in einigen Grazer Hs. \u196 \'c4hnliches Initium in Augsburg, SuStB, fol. cod. 292, f.200ra; Stuttgart, WLB, HB, I 108, f.153v; Bad Windesheim, StB, 83, f.9v; W\u252 \'fcrzburg, M. ch. o. 30, f.131r. Siehe auch \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Schneyer\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , 8,626. \line 150r\endash 151v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Laudem dicite deo nostro omnes sancti eius et qui timetis deum, Ps. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Apoc 19,5)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . Omnium sanctorum festivitas quatuor de causis instituta videtur ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... a gloria quam iam possident in celo; quam gloriam nobis ... benedictus. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Im Inhaltsverzeichnis f.232r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 De omnibus sanctis 148. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 151v\endash 152r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Beati qui habitant in domo tua ..., Ps. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (83,5)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . In verbis istis propheta spiritu dei plenus facit mencionem de tribus, scilicet de domo domini ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... Septimum est omnium predictorum eterna securitas, Io. III: Gaudium vestrum nemo tollet a vobis. Rogemus etc. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Im Inhaltsverzeichnis f.231v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 De dedicacione 149. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash Vgl. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Schneyer\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 4,146. \line 152v\endash 153v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Vox exultacionis et salutis in tabernaculis iustorum, Ps. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (117,15)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . Notandum quod est quintuplex vox. Prima est dyaboli decipientis, secunda est dei ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... cum tota celesti curia triplex sanctus sanctus sanctus dominus deus sabaoth. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Im Inhaltsverzeichnis f.231v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 De dedicacione 150. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 153v\endash 154r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Beati qui audiunt verbum dei et custodiunt illud, Luc. 11 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (28)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . Nota duo qualiter sit audiendum verbum dei et propter quid ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... Exemplum de illo qui numquam voluit audire verbum dei cum tamen multociens hortaretur per uxorem que honesta erat, sed nichil proficeret etc. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Im Inhaltsverzeichnis f.231v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 In die parasceues 152. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash Vgl. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Schneyer\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 7,423; 3,487. \emdash Rest der Seite leer. \line 154v\endash 157r Iacobus de Voragine: Sermo (ex quadragesimali) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Sciens Ihesus quia omnia consummata sunt ut conservaretur (!) scriptura dixit Sicio, illi autem spongiam etc., Io. 18 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Ioh 19,28)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . Ihesus Christus dominus noster in vita sua multa documenta dederat Iudeis, multa bona exempla exhibuerat sanctitatis ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... Talibus dicetur: Veniat mors super illos et de\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 [scendant]\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 in infernum (?) viventes \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Ps 54,16). \emdash Auch in Stams, Stiftsbibl., 11, f.173r\endash 174v ('In principio). }
Multae filiae congregaverunt divicias ... (Prv 31,29). Verbum istud exponitur de Maria virgine que hodie per glorie sublimitatem supergressa est
Verbum istud exponitur de Maria virgine que hodie per glorie sublimitatem supergressa est omnes creaturas
Ave gracia plena dominus tecum (Lc 1,28). In hoc ewangelio continetur exordium nostre salutis in quo quatuor notare possumus
In hoc ewangelio continet[ur] exordium nostre salutis in quo quatuor notare possumus
Laudem dicite deo nostro ... (Apoc 19,5). Omnium sanctorum festivitas quatuor de causis instituta videtur
Omnium sanctorum festivitas quatuor de causis instituta videtur
In verbis istis propheta spiritu dei plenus facit mencionem de tribus, scilicet de domo domini
Notandum quod est quintuplex vox. Prima est dyaboli decipientis, secunda est dei
Nota duo qualiter sit audiendum verbum dei et propter quid
Sciens Ihesus quia omnia consummata sunt ... (Ioh 18,28). Ihesus Christus dominus noster in vita sua multa documenta dederat

\uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 162r\endash 163v {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://bezwrk[0].6930/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Lectiones de sancto Wendelino}}\plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Lectio prima< Cum sancta mater ecclesia ad divinarum extollencias laudum in sanctorum meritis deo militari sit instituta, dignum videtur horum prestringere merita ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... prout sanctissimi patris Wendelini virtutum merita multipharie modisque multis declarant. \line >Lectio secunda< Hic igitur gloriosus confessor ex Scotie partibus parentibus Christianissimis ortus adhuc puerulus adeo etate sapiencia et gracia proficiebat ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 usw. \line \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Lectio nona< Cum igitur sanctus Wendelinus in huius vite agone decertasset cupiens dissolvi et cum Christo esse ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash 163v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... necnon plurimis choruscat virtutibus. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Unmittelbar anschlie\u223 \'dfend \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Nota< Nescio quomodo istud miraculum consonet veritati eo quod dicitur quod iste nuncius ... sanctum Wendelinum invenit ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... ad instar trium regum per plana et devia veperesque (!) transiliendo pervolasset etc. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash Im Inhaltsverzeichnis f.232r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 De sancto Wendelino lectiones 160. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash Rest der Seite leer. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 BHL Nr. 8845. AA SS Oct. IX 348\endash 349. }

\uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 164r\endash 168r {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://bezwrk[0].6930/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Sermones}}\plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 164r\endash v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Erunt signa in sole et luna et stellis ... universo orbi, Luc. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (21,25)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . In precedenti dominica egimus de adventu domini ... In ista vero dominica agimus de secundo adventu scilicet ad iudicium; in quo iudicio iudicabit omnem hominem ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... quod omnes qui videbunt eum timebunt et eciam sancti. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash Im Inhaltsverzeichnis f.231v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Dominica secunda adventus 162. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 165r\endash 166r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Veniet desideratus cunctis gentibus, Aggei 2\u176 \'b0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (8)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . In hiis verbis propheta consolatur sanctos patres et totum genus humanum qui diversis afflictionibus afflicti erant ante adventum Christi. Erant enim miseri triplici modo ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... ut suo sanguine frangeret adamantem et deleret peccatum. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash Im Inhaltsverzeichnis f.231v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 De adventu domini 163. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash Vgl. \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Venit desideratus ... Nota quod triplex est adventus Christi ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 in Graz, UB, 317, f.1. \line 166r\endash 167r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Ecce sacerdos magnus qui in diebus s.p.d., Sap. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Eccli 44,16)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . In verbis premissis duo notantur de beato Nicolao, cuius hodie festum colit sancta mater ecclesia. Primo fuit magnus ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... Post paucos dies predicti principes ad dei famulum veniunt et ad eius pedes se prosternunt. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Im Inhaltsverzeichnis f.232r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 De sancto Nicolao 164. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash Vgl. Stuttgart, WLB, HB I 228, f.47, und Kornik, Bibl. publ., 50, f.5 (\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Zathey\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , 1963 S.596). \line 167v\endash 168r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Redde quod debes etc. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Mt 18,28)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . Redde dico racionem de omnibus cogitacionibus et de omnibus verbis et factis quibus contra deum fecisti. O domine si reddituri sumus racionem de levibus verbis, quid tunc ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... quia tecum ad infernum descendo etc. De aliis accusatoribus quere in dominica de adventu. Ibi Erunt signa in sole etc. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Vgl. oben 164r\endash v. \emdash Im Inhaltsverzeichnis f.231v entweder \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Dominica 9a 165 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 oder \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Dominica 22a 165.}
Erunt signa in sole et luna et stellis ... , Luc. (21,25). In precedenti dominica egimus de adventu domini
In precedenti dominica egimus de adventu domini

In verbis premissis duo notantur de beato Nicolao, cuius hodie festum colit sancta mater ecclesia. Primo fuit magnus

\uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 168v\endash 170r {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://bezwrk[0].6930/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Notae und Gedichte}}\plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 De praesumptione et desperatione \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Nota que sunt magis nociva scilicet presumpcio et desperacio ... Deus dedit nobis duos in exemplum ne diffidamus scilicet Petrum ne de nobis multum presumamus et Paulum ne desperemus ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... et ne mali desperant (!). \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 De numero apostolorum \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Numerus apostolorum est prefiguratus in illis, primo per duodecim patriarchas, Gen. 29, Christianum populum generando; secundo per 12 principes tribuum ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... 15. per 12 stellas in corona sponse, Apoc. 12, ecclesiam miraculis et doctrinis illuminando. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 De fine mundi \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Si vis scire finem huius mundi, respice quando senes sunt sine sensu, populus sine devocione, divites sine caritate ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... Qui hec omnia bene considerat hodie predicta omnia reperiet. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 169r\endash 170r Salve regina (29 Strophen) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Salve regina virginum stella matutina / sordidorum criminum vera medicina / consolatrix hominum que (!) sunt in ruina / precibus precancium, mater, te inclina ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... Maria eximia tuum natum deprecare / ut quicumque omnia hec wlt recitare / in tui memoriam et te collaudare / dignetur in gloria sua collocare (!). Amen. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Walther\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , Initia 17147. Auch in Brno, SVK, R 349, f.217\endash 218. \emdash \line Im Inhaltsverzeichnis f.232r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Duo que sunt magis nociva et quod numerus apostolorum prefiguratus est in quindecim et de fine mundi et salve regina 167. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 169r Nota \u252 \'fcber Margarethes von Hennenberg Vielgeburt im Jahre 1275 (deutsch) (11 Zeilen) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Nota< Do man zalt von Cristus geburt M. CC\u176 \'b0. LXXV do gebar frow Margret von Hennenberg z\u251 \'fb ainem mal vnd z\u251 \'fb ainer geburt CCC LXIIII kinder. disu wurdund all get\u244 \'f4fft von ainem bischoff von \u219 \'dbtrecht der hies Gyo. Vnde waz du frow k\u252 \'fcnig Wilhams schwester ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... vnd ain clain mil von dem wylden gesalczen mer. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash Im Inhaltsverzeichnis f.232r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 De domina Margartha que in uno partu trecentos et sexaginta quatuor pueros peperit 168. }
Quare dies dominicus et dies sabbati et dies sexte ferie plus venerandi et honorandi sunt quam alii dies

{\rtf1\ansi\ansicpg0\uc1\deff0\deflang0\deflangfe0{\fonttbl{\f0\fnil\fcharset1 Arial;}{\f1\fnil\fcharset0 Times New Roman;}}{\colortbl;\red0\green0\blue0;\red0\green0\blue255;\red0\green255\blue255;\red0\green255\blue0;\red255\green0\blue255;\red255\green0\blue0;\red255\green255\blue0;\red255\green255\blue255;\red0\green0\blue128;\red0\green128\blue128;\red0\green128\blue0;\red128\green0\blue128;\red128\green0\blue0;\red128\green128\blue0;\red128\green128\blue128;\red192\green192\blue192;\red204\green238\blue221;}
\uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 184v\endash 194r {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://bezwrk[0].6930/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Sermones und Predigtmaterial}}\plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (184v\endash 186r) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Hic est discipulus quem diligebat Ihesus \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Leerraum, Ioh 21,24).\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Magna prerogativa in Iohanne perpenditur in hoc ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... Iste veneno potatus, exilio relegatus, in oleo ferventi balneatus etc. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (186v\endash 187r) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Transite ad me omnes qui concupiscitis me, Eccli. 24 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (26)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . Transivit ad eam ut concupiscens natura divina, natura humana, natura angelica ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... gaudent angeli laudantes. etc. Exemplum de milite qui fuit spoliator cui servierat dyabolus in specie humana; ille fuit talis consuetudinis quod omni die dicebat angelicam salutacionem etc. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (187v\endash 188r) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Vidit Iohannes in Apocalypsi librum scriptum intus et foris et VII sigillis clausum. Liber iste exponitur esse corpus Christi in sacramento altaris ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Erkl\u228 \'e4rung der sieben Siegel \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... Simile videmus in candela ardente quod non minoratur, ex hoc alie multe ab ea accendantur. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash Rest der Seite leer. \line (188v\endash 189v) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Ego sum pastor bonus \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Leerraum, Ioh 10,11)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . Notandum quod quilibet bonus pastor debet habere quinque. Primo debet habere panem ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... ut post hanc vitam perducat nos ad pascua celestia et eterna. Quod ipse prestare dignetur etc. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash Rest der Seite leer. \line (190r\endash 191r) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Genofefa virgo prope Parisius ad septem miliaria nata fuit. In cuius villam duo sancti episcopi scilicet Germanus et Lupus pernoctandi gracia dum irent ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... Quidam Gotto (!) dominica die operanti utraque manus contracta est, qui ad sepulchrum eius veniens curatus est. etc. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Auch in Freiburg, Universit\u228 \'e4tsbibliothek, 457, f.294va (siehe \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Hagenmaier\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ; 'In principio'). \line (191r obere Blatth\u228 \'e4lfte) sp\u228 \'e4ter eingetragen exegetische \u220 \'dcbung \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Ductus est Ihesus in desertum a spiritu ut temptaretur a dyabolo \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Mt 4,1)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . Expone totum ewangelium: In hoc ewangelio tria tanguntur, primum est quod per desertum significetur, in quo dominus temptatus fuit. Secundo ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... amaritudo. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (191v\endash 192r) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Nativitas tua dei genitrix virgo gaudium annunciavit universo mundo \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Antiphon)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . Nativitas beate Marie virginis triplex gaudium annunciavit, primo patri et matri quia eos liberavit a malediccione legis ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... et pauperibus elemosinas dando ut ipsa dignetur nos post hanc vitam ducere ad vitam eternam etc. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash Rest der Seite leer. \emdash Im Inhaltsverzeichnis f.232r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 De nativitate beate Marie 190. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (192v) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Probet autem se ipsum homo, Cor. 5 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (I Cor 11,28)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . Unde si ista quatuor habueris, secure sumere potes. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash Rest der Seite leer. \u196 \'c4hnliches Initium: Clm 28528, f.185vb (St\u252 \'fccke aus Iohannes de S. Capitulum primum de forma regis ...< \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 13ra \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Rex sic formam accepit ab inicio. Nam in solio positus ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 23va \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Incipit tractatus tercius de formis popularum (!). De agricula (!) caput primum< Popularum (!) formas et officia perstringentes ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 33ra \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Tractatus quartus de progressu eorum. Caput primum de Schahario in genere< De scacario locuturi sciendum est quod illud representat civitatem illam Babilonicam ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... Hunc autem libellum ad honorem et solacium et maxime ludum sciencium ego frater Iacobus de Cessulis (!) ... composui et ad hunc finem perduxi donante illo a quo procedit vel descendit omne datum opptimum (!) et omne donum perfectum, cui est honor et gloria in secula seculorum Amen. >Explicit ludus Scacorum deo gracias finitus et completus Anno domini Milesimo Quadringentesimo Decimo octavo In vigilia Petri et Pauli beatorum etc.< \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Kaeppeli\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , SOP, Nr.2066 (mit dieser Hs.) }

Henricus de Hassia suum ut sequitur dicendum pater noster. Divina sapiencia rebus omnibus decorem ordinis congruentis distribuens ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 52ra Ave Maria \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Ave Maria procul dubio illam sancte matris ecclesie generalem consuetudinem ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash 53vb \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... et in memoria exordii humane redempcionis atque taliter mortalibus exhibite divine miseracionis. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 53vb Zusatz \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Cum peccatores in peccato mortale existentes nolunt converti ad dominum et dicunt dominicam oracionem sic pater noster. Potest eis dicere dominus: non sum pater vester ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... sine consolacione perpetua relinquam; a quibus nos custodiat miseracio divina que sine fine vivit et regnat in secula seculorum Amen. >Explicit dominica oracio< \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Ave Maria Zusatz in einigen Hss. (Uppsala, Klosterneuburg), siehe 'In principio'. Super Ave Maria: \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Hain\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 8395}

\uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 71r\endash 73r{\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://bezwrk[0].6930/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Notae theologicae}}\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Item notandum quod Innocencius de vilitate humane condicionis dicit, quod unaquaque anima tam bona quam mala videt Christum in cruce ... Item notandum quod populus est colleccio tam nobilium quam ignobilium, sed plebs est collectio solum ignobilium. Queritur igitur ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 71v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >De parabola et fabula< Item est sciendum, quod predicare parabolice non fit per fabulas, sed per similitudines ... >De divite et camelo< >De heresi< \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 72r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >De Abel et Zacharia< >De Pylato< >De resurgentibus cum Christo< \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 72v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >De morte Marie virginis< In glosa prime ad Thessalonicenses ubi dicitur, quod qui rapiuntur ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... fuisset detenta etc. Iohannes de Bachone carmelita hec scribit. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 72v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Quomodo regule Christianorum sunt mitigate< Item notandum qualiter regula apostolica scilicet de possidendo omnia in communi fuit christianis mitigata. Respondetur quod per dispensacionem canonicam ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 73r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >De temporalibus bonis ob inicio ecclesie< Item notandum quod ab inicio ecclesie status eciam quo ad temporalia fuit a deo institutus. Dicitur enim in hystoriis quod cum Abel et Cayn obtulerunt munera ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... non est modo iniquitas sed vis. >Hec magister Iohannes de Bachone carmelita in lectura super Matheum 18\u176 \'b0 capitulo< \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 73r Endet mit 5 Zeilen \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >De miraculis malorum< Item notandum quare deus permittit malos facere miracula ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... deus tamen cuius invocacio fit honoratur. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash Zu Iohannes Baco siehe \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Lohr\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ; LdMA V,617; \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Stegm\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 \u252 \'fc\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 ller\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , Repert. sentent. 402, 529 und RB 4167}

\uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 73v\endash 74v {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://bezwrk[0].6930/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Quaestiones theologicae}}\plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (I) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Queritur utrum deus sit in genere aliquo, et videtur quod sic. Substancia enim est ens per se subsistens, hoc autem maxime deo convenit ... Sed tamen Paulus de Parusio ordinis fratrum beate Marie virginis Carmelitarum tenet oppositum libro primo articulo primo questionis illius, utrum deus sit summe simplex ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash 74r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... naturam individualem; igitur etc. >Hec Paulus de Parusio ordinis Carmelitarum< \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (II) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Queritur consequenter utrum deus sit idem quod sua essencia vel natura ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... non est idem suppositum et natura; igitur etc. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (III) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Queritur consequenter, utrum in deo sit idem essencia et esse, et videtur quod non; quia si sic, tunc ad esse divinum nil additur ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash 74v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... et hoc scimus ex eius effectibus, ut supra dictum est. etc. >Hec Thomas (sanctus)< \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Zusatz \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Quis sit verus humilis< Nota quod verus humilis gaudet cum despicitur, dolet si honoratur, gemit in prosperis, exultat in adversis ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... Quis est talis et laudabimus eum etc}

Quia Iudei in hac materia errant ex ignorancia distinguendi \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 no\plain \f1\i\super\lang1033\fs24 a\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 disting\plain \f1\i\super\lang1033\fs24 te\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 cod.)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 varios intellectus scripture ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 II 79rb \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Secunda questio< Utrum Iudei debeant credere predicacioni apostolorum secundum prophecias veteris legis ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 III 81rb \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Tercia< Utrum miracula que refert Matheus de Christo sic concordent prophetis, quod ex concordia eorundem possit probari ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 IV 83ra \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Quarta< Utrum miracula que refert Iohannes de Christo sic concordant prophetis (!) de Christo ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 V 86rb \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Quinta< Utrum retorquendo argumenta Iudeorum contra se ipsos probari possit, quod lex Christi ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 VI 89rb \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Sexta questio< Utrum bonus Christianus poterit ex precedentibus questionibus hoc sufficienter confutare ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... ergo perfidia Antichristi est confutanda. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Stegm\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 \u252 \'fc\plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 ller\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , RS, Nr.402 (mit dieser Hs. 'IV prol. q.1\endash 7'). N.F. 19), S.2 Anm.19 (Hs. genannt). \emdash Druck: Baco, Johannes: Liber quartus super Sententias, Mediolanum, 1510.}

\uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 97r\endash 98rb {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://bezwrk[0].6930/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Quaestiones theologicae de aeternitate, tempore, caritate}}\plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Queritur utrum diffinitio eternitatis sit bona, quam ponit Boecius 5\u176 \'b0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (pr.6, 8)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 de consolacione dicens, quod eternitas est interminabilis vite tota simul et perfecta possessio ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... ut motus celi secundum quosdam philosophos, tamen dominus ultra, in quantum eius regnum est totum simul etc. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 97va \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Queritur de eternitate, quid sit eternitas secundum nomen, utrum scilicet sit idem sempiternitas vel perpetuitas ... Secundo queritur utrum eternitas sit una vel plures. Et videtur quod una, quia eternitas ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 97vb De aevo \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 De evo queritur utrum sit unum vel plura; videtur quod unum ... Secundo queritur, an evum sit simplex vel compositum. Et videtur quod compositum ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 98ra De tempore \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 De tempore queritur et de substancia eius, utrum videlicet nunc sit de substancia eius. Videtur quod non, quia sicud se habet punctus ad lineam ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash 98rb \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... et ideo argumentum non valet. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 De caritate \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 De caritate queritur, utrum caritas sit maximum donum. Sed caritas non est donum, ut patet Ysa. XI\u176 \'b0 ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... Solucio ... Secundo quia in mente introducit ad regnum, igitur etc}

Ambrosius: Penitencia est preterita mala plangere ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 151vb \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Queritur utrum aliquid sit peccatum, quod per penitenciam non possit deleri. Dicendum quod ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 153ra \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Quot sunt partes penitencie. Dicendum quod penitencie tres sunt partes ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 154va \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Qualiter homo carens gracia compunccionis lacrimarum et eam desiderat habere, per quem modum possit illam a deo obtinere ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 usw. \line 156ra \u220 \'dcber Confessio \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Queritur ergo, quid sit confessio. Confessio est secundum Augustinum, prout Thomas in IIII\u176 \'b0 distinccione XVIIa posuit, morbus latens spe venie aperitur ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 157ra \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Qualis autem debeat esse confessio. Confessio secundum Thomam ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 159rb \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Utrum confessio sit iteranda. Nota quod confessio semel facta bona fide ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 161ra \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >De sigillo confessionis< Queritur utrum sacerdos in omni confessionis causa teneatur celare confessionem ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 161rb \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Sequitur nunc de satisfaccione< Satisfaccio secundum beatum Augustinum est causas peccatorum excidere ..., secundum vero Anshelmum libro II\u176 \'b0 Cur deus homo: Satisfacere deo est ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... dicit Augustinus: Mens aviditate ciborum lassata perdit virtutem ieiunii. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Vgl. Duranti in racionali divinorum libro VI\u176 \'b0 titulo de ieiunio in communi< Auctoritas ieiunii est ex tribus, ex persona, ex loco et ex tempore. Ex persona quia precepit deus Ade et Eve ut abstinerent ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash Endet mit \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Videndum est de tercio scilicet de vigilia seu vigiliis ... ... qui sobrie vivit agilior. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 166va, 167vb\endash 168va Guillelmus Altissiodorensis: Excerpta \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Super illud Matthei XXVI Pater si fieri potest< Wilhelmus Altissiodorensis super tercium sentenciarum capitulo XXIIII dicit, quod in Christo fuit duplex voluntas, scilicet voluntas creata ... \line >Super illud apostoli: Christus mortuus est ...< Dicit Wilhelmus Altissiodorensis super tercium sentenciarum capitulo XVII, quod Christus fuit mortuus ut nos moreremur ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 168ra \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Nota aliquas raciones quare filius dei incarnari et mori [voluit]< Wilhelmus Altissiodorensis super tercium sentenciarum capitulo 34 posuit tres raciones quare deus voluit incarnari ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Weitere Exzerpte folgen aus Kap. 39, 44, 45,48, 56. \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... dicti apostolus. Karissimi, sicut heri audistis, assercionem divini iudicii ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 223ra \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Ecce rex tuus venit, ubi supra. Gregorius in quadam omelia de martiribus: In fine mundi omnia consumenda ante consummacionem eciam probantur ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 223vb \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Ecce rex tuus venit, ubi supra. Quartum terribile precedens divinum iudicium est corporum resurreccio. Unde ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 224vb \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Ecce rex tuus venit, loco ubi supra. Juni 1448)}}\plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Nicolaus episcopus servus servorum dei universis et singulis venerabilibus fratribus patriarchis archiepiscopis episcopis ac dilectis filiis ... salutem et benediccionem apostolicam. Provisionis nostre debet provenire subsidia ut ea que a bone memorie predecessoribus nostris in religionis augmentum utiliter gesta sunt ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... se noverint incursurum. Datum Rome aput sanctum Petrum anno incarnacionis dominice millesimo quadragesimo quadringentesimo octavo tercio Kalendas Iulii pontificatus nostri anno secundo dd. (!) \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Zu der im Text zitierten Bulle Eugens IV. am Rand (252v) von der Hand des Schreibers: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Bulla habetur Nurberge quam occulis vidi et legi. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash Nach 252v fehlt ein Blatt. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Vgl. MGH Epist. saec. XIII, 3, 1894, 510. Auch in N\u252 \'fcrnberg, StB, Cent. V, 73, f.79r\endash 81r (auch hier Hinweis auf Aufbewahrungsort \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs20 ... bulla ... habetur Nuremberge apud predicatores\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 ) und N\u252 \'fcrnberg, StB, Cent. VII,3 f.149v\endash 153v. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 250v\endash 250r Materialien zur Beichtkontroverse (1) Beginnt auf 250v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 In primo ffateor IIIIor ordines mendicancium posse audire confessiones et absolvere ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Artikel gez\u228 \'e4hlt bis Nr.16: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Intromittunt se de testamentis faciendis et expediendis ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Unterschrift zum vorangehenden: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Isti sunt articuli plebani sancti Sebaldi Heinrici Letteburg propositi consulatui Nurburgensi feria quinta ante Mathiam anno L.< \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash (2) \u220 \'dcberschrift zum folgenden: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Brevissime responsiones super ipso articulo plebani sancti Sebaldi contra religiosos< Super primo articulo quo dicitur 'Fateor' etc. ... respondemus quod novimus ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Alle 16 Artikel werden beantwortet; Text wird fortgesetzt auf 250r, endet: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... Ex predictis igitur responsionibus patet, quod dictus dominus habuit (?) solum occasionem recedendi ab obiectis (?) et lites suscitare. Et hec sunt dicta in genere sicut sonat sua contra nos proposita in genere supposita correccione in hiis videri (?) benigna. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash Abschlie\u223 \'dfend (250r unten) zwei kirchenrechtliche Exzerpte. \emdash Datiert (250v) 1450. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 Einschaltblatt 249rv Panormitanus (Nicolaus de Tudeschis): Commentum ad X. 3.29.2 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Panormilitanus (!) super III\u176 \'b0 capitulo ut dominicis< Sed quero numquid indisti[n]cte peccet parrochianus non audiendo missam in diebus festivis ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Auch in N\u252 \'fcrnberg, StB, Cent. VII,3 f.176v\endash 177v (umfangreicher).}

Quando aliquis rex venturus est in aliquam civitatem, multi nunccii precedunt eius adventum ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... creaturam testem habere oportebat. Amen. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 285rb\endash 286ra \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Ewangeliso vobis gaudium magnum ..., Luce II\u176 \'b0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (10)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . Circa nativitatem salvatoris duo ostendit angelus in verbis premissis; primo quod eius nativitas sit multe iocunditatis ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... et culpam delevit et penam. Rogemus. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 286ra\endash 288va \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Item alius< Veniens et (!) ewangelisavit pacem ... ad patrem, Philipp. II\u176 \'b0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Eph 2,17)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . Christus in hoc mundo per carnem assumptam venit ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... et ingredietur et pascua inveniet. Rgoemus ergo dominus. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 288va\endash 289vb \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >De sancto Iohanne ewangelista< Quartum animal simile aquile, Apok. IIII\u176 \'b0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (7)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . Iohannes ewangelista per aquilam figuratur, quia ceteris ewangelistis acucius vidit ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... quidquid vero sincerum est meliorat suo igne et cetera. Rogemus. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 289vb\endash 291ra \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Item alius< Dilectus meus michi et ego illi, Cant. II \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (16)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . Potest esse vox Christi loquentis de beato Iohanne ewangelista. Dicit igitur Dilectus meus Iohannes est ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... Petrus maiora fecit miracula, Iohannes alciora protulit misteria. Rogemus. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 291ra\endash vb \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >De sancto Stephano< Ihersualem Iherusalem que occidis prophetas et lapidas eos qui ad te missi sunt, Mt. XXIII \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (37)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . Fulgencius dicit ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... preelectus a deo etc. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 291vb\endash 292va \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Pro novo anno< Argentum et aurum non est michi, hoc autem quod habeo, hoc tibi do, Actuum III\u176 \'b0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (6)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . Nunc in novo anno pro informacione intendo ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... nisi restituatur ablatum, XIII q. VI si res. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 292va\endash 293ra \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Aliud< Nunc in presenti sermone volo dividere illud dulce nomen Ihesus pro novo anno. Ihesus habet quinque litteras ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... qui perseveraverit usque in finem hic salvus erit. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash Rest der Spalte und 293rb\endash vb leer. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Zu 288va vgl. Uppsala, UB, C 47, f.279. Vgl. auch \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Glorieux\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , R\u233 \'e9pertoire, I 110\endash 111f Nr.17. \emdash Zu 289vb vgl. \uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 294r\endash 302v, 307r-308r {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://bezper[0].4100/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Karolus IV}}\plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 : {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://bezwrk[0].6930/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Aurea bulla}}\plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 In nomine sancte et individue trinitatis feliciter amen. Karolus quartus divina favente clemencia Romanorum imperator ... Omne regnum in se divisum dissolabitur (!) ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash Endet 299r von erster Hand mit Kap. XVI (De pfalburgeriis) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... qui recepti fuerint irremissibiliter applicentur etc. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Von einer sp\u228 \'e4teren Hand nachgetragen ab Kap. XVII \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >De diffidacionibus< Eos qui de cetro (!) adversus aliquos iustam (?) causam se habere fingentes ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash 300v \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... et tunc demum ad premissa procedat seu quodlibet premissorum. Explicit aurea bulla Karoli quarti Romanorum Bohemorum regis. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Es folgen die 'Metzer Gesetze' \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Infrascripte leges promulgate sunt in curia Metensi per dominum Karolum quartum Romanorum imperatorem et Bohemie regem augustensem anno domini millesimo tricentesimo quinquagesimo sexto ... ... in die nativitatis Christi \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (so auch Zeugen bF)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 301r \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Si quis cum principibus militibus vel privatis ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 bis Kap.XXVII (302r), das 302v endet (S.85, Z.10): \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ...in medio procedente et aliis duobus ex alterutro latere. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 307r\endash 308r: Kap. XXVII bis Schlu\u223 \'df von anderer Hand \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 De officiis principum electorum in solempnibus curiis imperatorum ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... in lingwagiis (?) ipsis valeant erudiri. >Expliciunt leges imperiales Karoli quarti Romanorum imperatoris semper augusti de officiis principum sacri imperii electorum< \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Ausgabe: Bulla aurea Karoli IV. imperatoris, ed. W.D. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Fritz\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Weimar 1972 (MGH Fontes iuris Germanici antiqui, XI), S.44\endash 90; S.30 (Hs. genannt). \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 302v Nota de bonis (von derselben Hand wie das vorangehende) \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Item sunt bona temporalia prata vinea fundus ... Item sunt bona naturalia ... Item sunt bona supernaturalia ... Item sunt bona supercelestia ut vita sanctorum, angelorum et omnium qui gloriantur in celo. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 302v Predigtentwurf \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Annunccio vobis gaudium magnum quia natus est salvator mundi, Luce II\u176 \'b0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (10)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . Karissimi, Ewax in libro de sigillis lapidum dicit: Gemma quelibet preciosa in terra nata ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Evax: vgl. Marbods 'Liber lapidum') \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... generacionem eius quis enarrabit. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash Rest der Seite und 303 leer. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 Einschaltblatt 304v Nota de peccato mortali \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Peccatum mortale est quod fit cum actuali libera racione aderente (!) voluntatis desidero contraria preceptis divine maiestatis: summa beati Thome 2e c.8 d.12. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ('aderente': Italianismus?) \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 305r Excerptum de Hilderico rege \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Postremo cum idem Hildericus se transtulit a Thuringia (?) per Franconiam, que Francia minor et superior dicitur ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... per quem erecta est ista provincia usque in hodiernam diem. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash Rest der Seite und 305v\endash 306v leer.}

\uc1 \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 308r\endash 314r {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://bezper[0].4100/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Alexander von Roes}}\plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 : {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://bezwrk[0].6930/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Memoriale}}\plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Sequitur Coronica (!) de translacione imperii< Multifarie multisque modis dominus universorum in diebus sue carnis dignatus est honorare Romanum imperium ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... et fides katholica dilatetur et crescat ad laudem et gloriam nominis sui qui est benedictus in secula seculorum. Amen. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash Rest von 314r\endash 316r leer. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Ed. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Grundmann/Heimpel\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , 1949 (MGH Deutsches MA, 4). Erw\u228 \'e4hnt bei \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Rosenfeld\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Mlat. Jb. 2, 1965, S.190. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 316v Formula exauctorandi praesulem \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Aufferimus tibi mitram pontificalem, dignitatis insigne teque predicandi auctoritate et officio designato in illa eximimus et privamus. Aufferimus tibi baculum pastorale ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... Aufferimus tibi habitum clericalem ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 endet \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... sentenciam moderetur. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Es folgt von gleicher Hand eine Nachbemerkung \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Hac per hoc maga (!) auctoritatis ista habenda est in ecclesia ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 schlie\u223 \'dft \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... et cum magna auctoritate a posteris destruantur (?). LXIII dist. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Marginalien (theologische) auf unterem Blattrand. \emdash Vgl. Michel \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs24 Andrieu\plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 , Le Pontifical Romain au Moyen-Age I\endash IV, Vaticano 1938\endash 1941 (Studi e Testi 86\endash 88, 99?) . }

II \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (33)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . Naturali quodam affectu diliguntur infantes ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... ideoque per mortem istum gratifficant nos in dilecto filio, ut dicit apostolous ad Hebreos. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 334rb\endash 338ra \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Defuncto Herode ecce angelus domini apparuit Ioseph in sompniis etc., Mathei \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (2,19)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . Querunt aliqui frequenter, quare mali homines veniunt in hoc mundo; quibus respondit beatus Augustinus ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... mutato nomine dicti sunt Cristiani. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 338ra\endash 340rb \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Postquam consumati sunt dies octo ut circumcideretur puer ... Ihesus, Luc. II\u176 \'b0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (21)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . Karissimi, solent enim seculares ante ante ianuas hominum nunc temporis nova cantica resonare ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... Eccli. XLVII \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (17)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 : Ad insulas longe dewlgatum est nomen tuum, quia agemus. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Rest der Spalte leer.) \line 340va\endash vb \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Cum natus esset Ihesus in Bethleem Iude in diebus Herodis regis, Mathei II\u176 \'b0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (1)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . Commune enim est proverbium ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... ubi superhabundavit delictum, superhabundavit et gracia. Tocius ergo // \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Abbruch, Reklamant:\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 malicie iniquitatis. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash Im Inhaltsverzeichnis vorn aufgef\u252 \'fchrt als \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Postilla ewangelii de dominica infra octavam nativitatis Christi. Postilla ewangelii in vigilia epiphanie domini. Sermo de circumcisione domini.}

XVI \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (16)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . Naturale est inter amicos, quod cupiunt mutua visione perfrui, locucione mutua refici, a corporali presencia consolari ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... Surgite et ite quia non habetis hic requiem. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (2) 356ra\endash 360rb \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Vado ad eum qui me misit, Ioh. XVI \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (5)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . Quasi dicat Vado paciendo resurgendo ascendendo ad eum idest patrem qui misit me idest incarnari constituit ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 356va \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... Sequitur: Cum autem venerit paraclitus qui consolatur ... ... Sequitur: Ille arguet idest reprehendit ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 357ra \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Ille arguet mundum de peccato \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Ioh. 16,8)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . Que commisimus, que numerare non sufficimus. Psalmista: Circumdederunt me mala ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... Arguam te et statuam contra faciem tuam. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (3) 360va\endash 362ra \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Amen amen dico vobis, si quid pecieritis ... dabit vobis, Ioh. XVI \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (23)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . Gemina ista affirmacio ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (4) 362ra\endash 363rb \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Absque synagogis facient vos etc., Ioh. XVI \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (2)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . Quia discipuli multa adversa erant passuri ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... impediunt. Si de duabus membris ultimis volueris loqui, videas Iacobum de Voragine in sermone tercio de presenti dominica. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (5) 363rb\endash 366rb \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Paraclitus autem spiritus sanctus quem mittit ... omnia, Iohannis XIIII \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (26)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . Nota quod spiritus sanctus multis modis datur animabus electis ... \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (6) 366rb\endash va \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Descendit ignis de celo a deo, Apok. XIII \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (Apc 20,9)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . Quandoque contingit secundum naturam, quod post recessum nubis a terra et ascensum eius ad celum ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... facit bulire aquam que erat frigida, quod eam calefacit // \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Abbruch. \emdash Im Inhaltsverzeichnis vorne aufgef\u252 \'fchrt als \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Sermo de dominica 3a post pasca. Sermo perutilis de dominica 4a post pasca. Sermo de dominica 5a post pasca. Sermo de dominica infra octavam ascensionis domini. Sermo bonus de festo penthecostes. Sermo pro feria 2a penthecostes. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash 266vb leer. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 (1) \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Schneyer\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , III 436. \u196 \'c4hnliche Initien siehe 'In principio'. (2) Vgl. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Schneyer\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , VIII 561 ('Vado ... Quasi dicat vado immo'). (3) Vgl. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Schneyer\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , III 341. Iacobus a Voragine als Sermo in dominica infra oct. ascensionis zugeschrieben in Basel, UB, B VI 8, f.123. (4) Vgl. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Schneyer\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , III 227. (6) Vgl. Stuttgart, WLB, HB III 54}

Qui recte sapiunt et quod necessarium sit audientibus intelligunt, ista die de tribus predicare consweverunt ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... In precedenti dominica imploravit ecclesia divinum auxilium in introitu misse dicens illud Psalmi: Domine in tua misericordia speravi ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... qui fuerunt primi magistri. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Hieran anschlie\u223 \'dfend (379ra\endash vb) Exzerpte unter der \u220 \'dcberschrift \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Nota de dileccione< Beatus Gregorius loquens de caritate quam ad nos habuit sic dicit: unus ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... dileccio malum non operatur. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (5) 380ra\endash 382ra \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Erant appropinquantes ad Ihesum publicani et peccatores, Luc. XV \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (1)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . Postquam nos sancta mater ecclesia in dominicis precedentibus docuit exercere caritatem quantum ad deum et proximum, modo docet nos inherere fundamento virtutum ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... ergo autem in ea natus sum. Ad quam. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (6) 383ra\endash 383va \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Per totam noctem laborantes nichil cepimus lucis, Luc. V \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (5)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . Docet nos mater ecclesia hodie unanimiter et ut in omni actu virtuoso simus unanimes ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... Ieronimus: Cum cetera vicia senescunt, sola avaricia iuvenescit; unde omnes isti laborant in nocte. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (7) 383va\endash 385va \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Si offers munus tuum ante altare et ibi recordatus fueris etc., Mathei V \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (23)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . Docet nos dominus in presenti ewangelio supereminenciam nove legis ad legem veterem ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... tetigi labia tua. etc. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (8) 385va\endash 387rb \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Cum turba multa esset cum Ihesu, Marci VIII \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (1)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . In isto ewangelio ostendatur magna dei misericordia ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... ut intrant in structuram sempiternam. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (9) 387rb\endash 389rb \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Venit filius hominis querere et salvum facere quod perierat, Luc. XIX \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (19)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . Cum igitur multi dampnantur et pauci salvantur, posset aliquis dicere, quod frustra venit filius hominis ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 .... suis dilectoribus ablaturum. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (10) 389rb\endash 390ra \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Attendite a falsis prohetis, Mt. VII \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (15)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . Docet dominus in presenti ewangelio quid facere et quid fugere debeamus ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... Item promittit requiem et dat laborem et punccionem, unde dominus Mathei XII. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Zwei Zeilen leer. Auf unterem Blattrand ein Zusatz. \line (11) 390rb\endash va \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Homo quidam erat dives qui habebat villicum, Luc. XVI. Agit hic dominus in presenti ewangelio de illo districto examine iudicii quod requiritur ab unoquoque in fine vite sue ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... velut dicit glosa: quibus iniquus mammon preest ut partus temptet homines. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Die bis 399v folgenden Sermones (s.u.) sind meist mit einem marginalen Titel versehen. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb0\sa0\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 Zu (3) vgl. \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Schneyer\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , IX 849 ('Eorum qui recte sapiunt'). (4) \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Schneyer\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , I 283 ('In praecedenti dominica ecclesia'); IV 45 ('In praecedenti dominica imploravit'). }

In verbis istis explicatur nobis beate Marie virginis ortus ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... quam merite dictum sit et nomen virginis Maria. Hec ille. Rogemus. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (2) 395rb\endash 395vb \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 >Alius sermo de nativitate virginis< Canit ecclesia: Nativitas tua dei genitrix virgo gaudium etc., et hoc propter plenitudinem perfectionum mulier pariens ... ... respexit deus humilitatem ancille sue. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (3) 395vb\endash 396va \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Considerate lilia agri quomodo crescunt, non laborant neque nent, Math. VI\u176 \'b0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (27)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . Dominus volens nos revocare a sollicitudine et amore temporalium ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... quibus vos glorificavit. Amen. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 (1) Vgl. L\u252 \'fcneburg, RatsB, Ms. Theol. quart 22, f.168ra. \emdash (2) 'Nativitas tua...' Antiphon in mehreren Zeugen \u252 \'fcberliefert (vgl. 'In principio'). \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 396va\endash 399va Sermones (1) 396va\endash 397ra \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Domus quam edificare cupio \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 ('volo' gestrichen)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 magna est nimis et inclita, II\u176 \'b0 Paralippomenon II\u176 \'b0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (9)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . Hec domus est vero (?) magna, que homine edificatur est a vero (?) Salomone qui pacificus dicitur ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... sancti spiritus ymbre perfusa est omnis creatura. Rogemus. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (2) 397ra\endash 398vb \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Adolescens tibi dico: surge, Luce VII\u176 \'b0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (14)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . Immensitatem sue misericordie ostendit dominus in hoc ewangelio in eo quod misertus vidue ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 397vb \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... Surge qui dormis, Proverb. VI \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (9)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Usquequo piger dormis. \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Fortgesetzt 398vb \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... dico surge ad vitam gracie. Quod nobis etc. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Theologische Noten (397vb\endash 398rb) eingef\u252 \'fcgt. \line (3) 398va\endash 399ra \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Simile est regnum celorum homini regi qui fecit nupcias filio suo, Mathei XXII \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (2)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . Quia in ewangelio presenti sub methaphora nupciarum vocamur ad convivium celeste ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... ratificatur vero in iudicio et iusticia \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash Abbruch?, auf unterem Rand: \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 in cedula tali sub signo 'Gaf'. \line \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (4) 399rb\endash va \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Erat quidam regulus, Ioh. IIII\u176 \'b0 \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 (46)\plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 . Docet nos dominus in presenti ewangelio in omnibus nostris tribulacionibus ad ipsum recurrere ... \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 \emdash \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 ... que sunt super terram. Tria enim requiruntur in rege \plain \f1\lang1033\fs24 Abbruch. \emdash Rest der Seite leer. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 398ra unten {\field{\*\fldinst HYPERLINK "hida://bezwrk[1].6930/?u"}{\fldrslt \plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24\chcbpat17 Versus (4)}}\plain \f1\b\lang1033\fs24 \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\i\lang1033\fs24 Perfidus inspiciat Petrum predoque latronem, \line crudelis Paulum, quem punit gaza Matheum, \line Zacheum cupidus immundet (?) carne Mariam: \line Hos deus exemplum concessit nobis habendum. \par \pard\fi0\li0\ql\ri0\sb105\sa105\itap0 \plain \f1\scaps\lang1033\fs20 Walther\plain \f1\lang1033\fs20 , Initia 13982.
